title: Firm Administrator (Operations + Billing) @ BBA Law
description:
Compensation: $2,000 USD/month



Time Commitment: ~40+ available hours/weekly



Working Hours: 8:00am–5:00pm EST (or longer as required to get the work done)



Engagement Type: Independent Contractor



Location: Remote (US-based hours required)



English Mastery and Working Culture Notice: Native-sounding and command-of-spoken English (and, of course, written English) is imperative in this role, as you will be working directly with U.S.-based Sales leadership and team members. Please do not apply if you do not meet this requirement. Additionally, prior experience working with U.S. companies and operating in fast-paced, high-performance environments is critical.



Are you driven to streamline operations while being the backbone of a thriving law firm?



Do you excel at catching errors before they become significant issues and thrive on accountability?



Can you transform operational chaos into well-oiled efficiency with minimal supervision?



Is your problem-solving proactive and innovative, capturing missed opportunities for improvement?



Final question: When faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?



The Firm Administrator at BBA Law is a newly created role that aims to streamline operations, allowing firm leadership to focus on growth and client advocacy. As the operational right hand, you will have a direct impact on improving efficiencies and ensuring the smooth functioning of firm operations, all while supporting the firm's mission of delivering superior legal solutions to Michigan families.

 



What you’ll do:

- Billing and Financial Oversight: Own key aspects of the billing cycle by reviewing time entries for accuracy, capturing billable activities and expenses, preparing invoices, and maintaining consistent accounts receivable follow-up.

- Operational Compliance: Monitor day-to-day staff activity and matter workflows, catching errors, missing information, and incomplete steps before they become larger operational issues.

- Lead and CRM Management: Ensure leads are accurately captured, properly tracked, and followed up on promptly, while maintaining clean CRM data and identifying opportunities to improve the intake process.

- Administrative Support: Serve as an operational extension of firm leadership, coordinating administrative priorities, supporting key workflows, and ensuring important follow-up does not fall through the cracks.

- Process Development: Build and maintain practical SOPs and repeatable processes that improve consistency, accountability, and efficiency across the firm.



What we’re looking for: 

- US Law Firm Experience: Experience in law firm operations, billing, bookkeeping, or office management is preferred, with an understanding of legal workflows being a strong advantage.

- Technology Proficiency: Comfortable working in Clio or similar practice management software, CRM systems, spreadsheets, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.

- Organizational Skills: Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to stay on top of multiple workflows, catch inconsistencies, and follow through without frequent reminders.

- Communication Skills: Clear and professional written and spoken English, with confidence communicating with staff, clients, vendors, and insurance providers.

- Proactive Problem Solver: Able to spot issues before they become larger problems, take initiative, and find solutions independently without requiring constant direction.

Remote Work Readiness & Reliability: Ability to work U.S. hours, with reliable access to necessary technology and demonstrated success working independently in a remote, structured work setting.



Why you should work here: 

- Impactful Role: For someone who thrives on making things work better, this role offers the opportunity to create meaningful improvements that will be felt across the firm as it continues to grow.

- Autonomous Environment: Ideal for someone who does their best work with trust and independence, this role offers meaningful ownership and the freedom to drive results without constant oversight.

- Leadership Exposure: Work closely with firm leadership in a highly visible role, gaining firsthand exposure to the priorities, challenges, and day-to-day operations of a growing law firm.

- Growth Opportunity: As the firm continues to scale, this role offers the opportunity to expand your impact and take on broader operational responsibilities in a larger operational role.

title: Appointment Recovery Specialist (SDR / Outbound Caller) — Rebook No-Shows & Cancellations
description:
RF Consultants is a U.S.-based consulting firm that helps individuals and business owners repair their credit profiles and access business funding. We generate a high volume of consultation bookings every week — and a meaningful percentage of those prospects don't show up or cancel before the call.



Those people still want help. They got busy, they got nervous, or life happened. Your job is to get them back on the calendar.



What You'll Actually Be Doing



This is not cold calling from a purchased list. Every person you contact has already raised their hand, filled out our form, and booked time with us. You're following up on warm, interested leads who dropped off.



Day to day:



Work a daily list of no-showed and cancelled appointments pulled from our CRM (GoHighLevel)

Call, text, and
 these leads until you reach them or they're properly disqualified

Handle the common objections: "I got busy," "I'm not ready," "I already found someone else," "How much does this cost?"

Rebook them directly onto a closer's calendar

Send confirmation and reminder touches so the rebooked appointment actually shows

Log every attempt, outcome, and note in the CRM — clean data is non-negotiable

Report daily on dials, contacts, rebooks, and shows



Expect roughly [60–100] dials per day plus text and
 follow-up.



Who We're Looking For



Required:



Fluent, neutral English with a clear phone voice — U.S. prospects should be comfortable talking to you

1+ years of outbound calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience with U.S. customers

Genuinely comfortable on the phone and unbothered by rejection or voi
 after voi

Reliable computer, noise-cancelling headset, quiet workspace, and stable internet (minimum 20 Mbps, with a backup connection)

Organized and consistent — you follow the cadence and update the CRM every single time

Available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Nice to have:



Experience in credit repair, financial services, insurance, or debt/lending

Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel

A track record you can point to with actual numbers



Important: You will never give credit, legal, or financial advice, and you will never promise a specific result, score increase, or funding amount. Your only job is to get the prospect back on the calendar with one of our consultants. We train you on exactly what you can and cannot say, and we hold that line strictly.



What We Offer

Warm leads only — no list-scraping, no dialing strangers

Scripts, objection frameworks, and call recordings to learn from

Base pay plus performance bonus, paid [twice monthly / monthly] via [payment method]

Long-term role with a growing U.S. company, not a short-term project

Direct feedback and coaching — we want you to get better, and we pay more when you do

How to Apply



Applications without all three items below will not be reviewed.



Put "REBOOK — [Your First Name]" in the subject line.

Attach a short resume or summary of your outbound calling experience, including your best numbers (dials/day, connect rate, set rate, show rate).

Record a 60–90 second voice sample (Vocaroo, Loom, or an MP3 link) role-playing this scenario:



You're calling Maria. She booked a free credit consultation with CRF Consultants for Tuesday at 2pm and didn't show up. This is your second attempt reaching her. She picks up and sounds rushed. Get her back on the calendar.

title: Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services
description:
Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services



We are looking for an experienced sales representative to join our team and sell home services to inbound leads.



This is not an entry-level sales position. We are looking for someone who already knows how to speak with homeowners, understand their needs, build trust quickly, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.



You will be speaking with customers who have already expressed interest in our services. Your job is to turn those opportunities into booked and paid jobs.



Responsibilities

Respond quickly to inbound phone, web, and other leads

Speak with homeowners about their project and understand exactly what they need

Explain our services and pricing clearly

Build trust and confidently guide customers toward purchasing

Handle common objections around price, timing, competitors, and project details

Follow up with leads who do not purchase immediately

Keep accurate notes and update lead statuses in our CRM

Meet sales and conversion targets

Communicate with the operations team when needed to ensure a smooth customer experience

Requirements

Previous sales experience is required

Strong preference for experience selling home services, construction, HVAC, landscaping, roofing, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, junk removal, materials, or similar services

Proven ability to close inbound leads

Excellent spoken and written English

Confident and natural on the phone

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the sale

Organized and able to manage multiple leads simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and professional working environment

Comfortable using CRMs, phone systems,
, and messaging tools

What We're Looking For



We want someone who thinks like a salesperson, not an order taker.



A good candidate understands that an inbound inquiry is an opportunity that needs to be worked. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying what matters to the customer, addressing concerns, creating urgency when appropriate, and directly asking the customer to move forward.



Experience and results matter more to us than formal education.



REQUIRED: Video Introduction



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please submit a 2–3 minute video recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



Tell us about your previous sales experience.

What products or services have you sold?

Have you sold home services or worked with homeowners before?

Were the leads inbound, outbound, or both?

What were your typical sales targets or results?

Give us an example of how you would respond to a customer who says, "Your price is too high. I need to think about it."

Why do you think you would be good at this role?



Please speak naturally. We are using the video primarily to evaluate your communication skills, English, confidence, and sales ability, not your video production skills.



How to Apply



Send us:



Your resume

Your video introduction

A short description of your most relevant sales experience

The types of products or services you have sold

Any sales numbers, close rates, quotas, or other performance metrics you can share



Again, sales experience and the video introduction are mandatory. Applications without both will be automatically rejected.

title: Video Editor – Short-Form Ads (Profit Share + Performance Bonuses)
description:
We are hiring 10 short-form video editors. Not one. Ten.



We are a fast growing e-commerce group with our own DTC brands across Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, the UK and more. Our ads reach over 100 million people every month, and we launch a new product almost every day. Video is our bottleneck, so we are building a team that runs seven days a week.



Because we are hiring ten, this is not a lottery where one person wins. Show a real portfolio, follow the onboarding, deliver in your first week, and you are in. Most people who do not make it here fail by ignoring instructions, not on talent.



WHAT YOU EARN



$200 USD per month base, guaranteed, paid weekly through PayPal.



Plus $25 for every ad of yours that reaches 10,000 SEK (about $900) in ad spend while holding a ROAS above 3.0.



Maximum $400 per month. We tell you the ceiling openly, because we do not promise numbers we will not pay.



HOW THE BONUS WORKS



Every ad you make is tracked. When one hits 10,000 SEK in spend and is still above 3.0 ROAS, that is a winner and you get $25. We check three days later, so late conversions count in your favour. Once earned it is yours, even if the ad fades afterwards. One bonus per ad.



WHERE THIS GOES

title: Senior Accountant — NetSuite / Multi-Entity
description:
Senior Accountant with multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience in a multi-entity environment, joining an established accounting team at an energy industry company. Immediate-start contract, 2–3 months, extension possible. Remote, full-time, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific.





Summary

Senior Accountant — NetSuite, Multi-Entity Contract (2–3 months, extension possible) · Remote · Full-time, US Pacific hours · Immediate start



Bridged Financial Solutions is a fully remote US accounting, tax, and fractional CFO firm. We are staffing a Senior Accountant for a client in the energy industry that runs NetSuite across a multi-entity structure.



The client has an established accounting department of roughly eight onshore staff. This role is additional capacity alongside that team — you will be working within their existing close process, standards, and review structure rather than building or running your own.



This is a hands-on production seat. You will be in NetSuite every day.



Scope

The exact task mix is being finalized as we determine which work moves to this role. It will draw from across the close cycle rather than sitting in one corner of the system, so what matters is that you can be handed any core piece of NetSuite.



You should have working command of, at minimum:



General ledger — journal entries, recurring and memorized entries, accruals, prepaids, allocation schedules

Period close — Period Close Checklist, A/P and A/R sub-period locking versus GL close, post-close corrections

Accounts payable — vendor bills, bill credits, payment runs, vendor records

Accounts receivable — invoicing, customer payments, credit memos, aging and collections

Banking and reconciliation — bank feeds and statement imports, account reconciliation, deposits, undeposited funds

Multi-subsidiary and consolidation — subsidiary hierarchy, intercompany transactions, eliminations, consolidated reporting

Segmentation — subsidiary, class, department, location, and custom segments, and when each should be used

Fixed assets — asset records, depreciation schedules, disposals

Reporting — standard financials, report customization, and saved searches (criteria, results, and formula fields)

System fundamentals — roles and permissions, audit trail and system notes, record hierarchy



Beyond the mechanics, we expect you to reconcile what you touch, document your workpapers so they stand on their own, and raise misclassifications, duplicates, and control gaps when you find them rather than booking around them.



Requirements

Multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience as a preparer — not a report consumer

Genuine multi-entity experience: multiple subsidiaries, intercompany activity, consolidated reporting

Strong month-end close and balance sheet reconciliation discipline

Advanced Excel at a workpaper-building level — pivots, lookups, clean tie-outs

Comfortable working in the Microsoft 365 environment — Teams, Outlook, SharePoint / OneDrive

Able to work effectively inside an established team: take direction, follow existing conventions, and communicate status without being chased

Written English strong enough to document your own work and escalate an issue clearly

Availability for the full US Pacific business day, Monday through Friday

Reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, a backup connection and power plan, and a private workspace



Nice to have

BS Accountancy; CPA or CPA candidate

Experience in energy, utilities, power generation, or another capital-intensive industry

Project or job costing experience

Prior experience supporting a US-based accounting department



Details

Independent contractor engaged directly by Bridged Financial Solutions

Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time

Initial term of 2–3 months with an immediate start; extension possible

Compensation: competitive, depending on experience

You provide your own equipment; we provide all software access

NDA and background check required before any client data access





Three to five sentences on the largest multi-entity NetSuite environment you have worked in — number of subsidiaries, currencies, and what you personally owned in the close

Your expected hourly rate (USD) and earliest start date



Applications missing #2 will not be reviewed.



B. Screening questions

Questions

1) What NetSuite role did you hold (Accountant / Controller / Administrator / custom)? Could you post journal entries and close periods yourself?

Separates preparers from people who ran reports out of someone else's instance.

2) In the largest environment you worked in: how many subsidiaries, how many currencies, and was it NetSuite OneWorld?

The single highest-value filter. A meaningful share of applicants describe several separate QuickBooks files as "multi-entity."

3) Can you commit to 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific, Monday through Friday, for the next three months? What other engagements would you be working around?

Moonlighting on top of an existing full-time job is the most common failure mode on contract hires.

4) Which of the following have you personally worked in: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, fixed assets, intercompany/eliminations, saved searches?

Breadth check, since the scope isn't fixed. Gaps aren't automatically disqualifying — clustering in only one or two is.

5) Describe the accounting team you last worked in. How many people, and where did your work go for review?

This role slots into an eight-person department. You want someone used to a review chain, not a sole-charge operator.

6) What is your internet speed, and what is your backup for outages?

7) Expected hourly rate in USD?





Technical screen 

1. "Walk me through your month-end close in NetSuite, day one to sign-off."



2. "How does NetSuite handle intercompany? Take one transaction from origination through elimination." 



3. "What's the difference between closing a period and locking a period? What do you do when a correction is needed after close?"



4. "Describe a saved search you built and why a standard report wouldn't do it.



5. "Tell me about a balance sheet account that wouldn't reconcile. How did you find the break?" 



6. "How do you d
 whether something should be tracked by class, department, location, or a custom segment?" 



7. "You're new to a team that already has its own way of doing things, and you think one of their reconciliation schedules is wrong. What do you do?"

title: AI Content & Social Media Manager
description:
AI Content & Social Media Manager



Long-Term Creative Partner — Seek Consciousness



I’m looking for a highly capable, independent thinker to help grow Seek Consciousness, a long-term project exploring consciousness, meditation, psychology, spirituality, ancient wisdom, modern science, healing, personal transformation, and direct experience.



This is not a standard social media manager position.



I’m not looking for someone who waits for me to tell them what to post every day. I’m looking for someone who can learn this work deeply, understand my voice and visual style, use AI intelligently, understand how social media actually works, and increasingly take ownership of this part of the project.



I can do this work myself, but it isn’t where my time is best spent. My focus needs to stay on creating the teachings, videos, writing, and larger Seek Consciousness project.



I’m not looking to micromanage you. I’m looking for a creative partner who can handle their business, think for themselves, and help us build this together.



⸻



THE PROJECT



Seek Consciousness brings together different paths, practices, teachings, and tools that can help people go deeper into themselves and consciousness, work through old patterns and trauma, and experience more presence, clarity, love, freedom, and aliveness in their lives.



There is already a large body of original material to work from:



* Long-form YouTube videos

* Full scripts and transcripts

* Shorts and Reels

* Written teachings and ideas

* Existing carousels and social posts

* AI-generated imagery

* Finished thumbnails

* Brand references and visual assets

* A growing YouTube library



Your job is not to use AI to invent new Seek Consciousness teachings.



The ideas come from my actual writing, videos, experiences, and body of work.



AI helps us find, organize, distill, restructure, research, visualize, and communicate those ideas more effectively.



For example, a 15-minute video may not contain a clean 60-second Short that can simply be clipped out.



You may find a great idea spread across several parts of the script, use AI to help restructure it into a strong 45–90 second piece while preserving my actual meaning and voice, and then give it back to me to rerecord.



Sometimes you’ll be extracting content.



Sometimes you’ll be reorganizing it.



Sometimes you’ll be helping us discover the shorter teaching hidden inside a larger one.



That kind of judgment is a major part of this role.



⸻



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Initially, we’re looking to create approximately 1–2 core pieces of content per day and adapt them appropriately across:



* Instagram

* TikTok

*

* YouTube Shorts



Your work may include:



* Finding strong Shorts and Reels inside existing scripts and videos

* Creating new short-form scripts for me to rerecord

* Designing finished 4–6 slide carousels

* Creating single-image posts and social graphics

* Writing captions, hooks, titles, descriptions, and CTAs

* Creating high-quality AI-generated imagery

* Learning and maintaining the Seek Consciousness visual style

* Using ChatGPT extensively as part of the creative process

* Carefully proofreading everything before it goes out

* Recognizing factual claims that should be researched or verified

* Adapting content intelligently across different platforms

* Scheduling and publishing approved content

* Maintaining a content calendar and backlog

* Reviewing analytics and identifying what is working

* Finding strong ideas that deserve additional versions or follow-ups

* Helping move people from short-form content toward our YouTube channel and website



As the role grows, you may also help manage:



* YouTube uploads

* Titles and descriptions

* Shorts strategy

* Playlists

* Thumbnails and packaging ideas

* End screens and pinned comments

* Overall channel organization and optimization



⸻



SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & GROWTH



This is an important part of the role.



I’m still learning the social-media side of this project, so I’m looking for someone who understands not only how to make good content, but also how to help the right people discover it.



You should have a strong working understanding of areas such as:



* Instagram Reels, carousels, Stories, collaborations, scheduling, and analytics

* TikTok discovery, search, posting, trends, and platform-specific formatting

*
 distribution

* YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube strategy

* Hooks and viewer retention

* Watch time

* Click-through rate

* Saves, shares, comments, and meaningful engagement

* Search-friendly titles, captions, keywords, and descriptions

* Content calendars and scheduling

* Cross-platform repurposing

* Organic growth strategies

* Collaborations and promotion

* Understanding when content should be reused and when it should be adapted

* Recognizing why something worked and what we should test next



I’m not looking for someone who blindly follows social-media formulas or chases every trend.



I want someone who understands the platforms well enough to bring ideas to the table and help us use them intelligently.



There will be things I can teach you about AI, writing, imagery, and Seek Consciousness.



There should also be things we can learn from each other.



⸻



AI IS A MAJOR PART OF THIS ROLE



I use ChatGPT extensively, and right now it works particularly well with my voice and existing body of work.



I have also developed specific methods for:



* Working with AI while preserving my actual writing style

* Pulling new content from long-form material

* Refining scripts

* Creating AI imagery

* Developing consistent visual styles

* Iterating until something actually feels right



I’ll teach you the methods and systems I’ve developed.



I’m also interested in the tools and processes you already use.



But one principle is extremely important:



AI is a tool, not an authority.



AI can produce something that sounds intelligent, looks beautiful, and is still wrong.



You need enough judgment to know when to question it, research something, rewrite it, reject an image, or ask for clarification.



⸻



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



We’re looking for an independent thinker, not simply an operator.



Someone who:



* Thinks for themselves

* Takes ownership of their work

* Doesn’t need to be told every next step

* Has excellent written English

* Is an excellent proofreader

* Has strong visual taste

* Has real social-media management experience

* Understands content strategy, distribution, analytics, and audience growth

* Is highly capable with ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Has real experience creating AI imagery

* Can learn an established visual style

* Understands that technically impressive work can still be wrong for the brand

* Can receive feedback and learn from it

* Has good research instincts

* Knows when something should be fact-checked

* Is comfortable saying when something doesn’t make sense

* Brings ideas rather than only completing assigned tasks

* Can prepare batches of strong work for approval

* Is organized and dependable

* Wants to become part of a team and help build something meaningful over time



You do not need to share any particular belief system.



Seek Consciousness itself is not about telling people what they must believe.



But you do need to be genuinely interested in subjects such as consciousness, spirituality, psychology, meditation, healing, personal growth, and exploring your own inner life.



You need to want to understand the material—not simply run it through AI and produce generic “spiritual content.”



⸻



THE TEAM



You won’t be working alone.



We already have a small creative team including:



* An experienced videographer/editor

* A webmaster

* A UI/UX specialist



Three members of the team are based in the Philippines, and they are genuinely wonderful people to work with.



You’ll be able to collaborate with the rest of the team, exchange ideas, ask for feedback, and help us grow the project together.



⸻



HOURS & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This will begin as a part-time role, approximately 15–25 hours per week.



The work will be largely asynchronous.



We’ll schedule meetings when they’re useful for reviewing work, planning, teaching new systems, or solving problems—not simply because we need another meeting on the calendar.



Ideally, you’ll prepare content in batches so I can spend an hour or two reviewing it, give you feedback, and then return my attention to creating.



This is intended to be a long-term position.



For the right person, it has the potential to grow into:



* Full-time work

* Greater responsibility

* Greater autonomy

* Increased compensation

* A core role within the Seek Consciousness team



I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with the project, not someone looking for a short freelance assignment.



⸻



PAID TRIAL



After reviewing applications, I plan to select a small number of finalists for a paid trial project.



The trial will use real Seek Consciousness material and may include:



* Finding Short/Reel ideas inside longer content

* Creating a new short-form script

* Designing a finished carousel

* Creating several AI-generated images

* Identifying which images work and which do not—and explaining why

* Writing platform-specific captions and content

* Explaining how you used AI

* Showing where you personally edited or improved AI output

* Sharing what opportunities you see that I may be missing



I’m interested in how you think, not simply how quickly you can produce something.



Finalists will receive more information about my AI and creative processes before completing the trial.



⸻



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the word:



CREATE



That lets me know you actually read this posting.



Please do not send only a generic résumé or canned application.



I want to hear from the actual person I may be working with.



Please tell me:



1. Why do you think you’re a particularly good fit for this project?

2. What experience do you have with:

    * Social-media management

    * Instagram

    * TikTok

    *

    * YouTube

    * Writing and proofreading

    * ChatGPT / AI

    * AI image generation

3. Show me examples of work you are genuinely proud of.

4. Tell me about a social-media account you have managed.

    What did you actually do, what changed while you managed it, and what metrics did you pay attention to?

5. Tell me how you currently use AI in your work.

6. What do you believe you are particularly good at?

7. Where would you still like to improve?

8. If you’re comfortable sharing it, tell me a little about your own connection to consciousness, spirituality, personal growth, or your inner life.



There is no correct belief or answer here. I simply want to understand the person I may be working with.



9. Tell me your current availability.

10. Please list your hourly rate.



And finally, answer this:



If I gave you a 20-minute Seek Consciousness video, its full transcript, and access to our visual library—but very little direction—how would you d
 what content to create from it and how you would distribute it across Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube?



I’m much more interested in a thoughtful response than a perfect résumé.



If this sounds like something you would genuinely enjoy helping us build, I’d love to hear from you.



YouTube 

Seek_Consciousness

Website

title: 3D Product Modeling & Visualization Artist
description:
About Us




 is a leading provider of high-quality cabinetry and spatial design solutions. We are dedicated to delivering top-tier craftsmanship, innovative storage concepts, and seamless customer experiences. We are seeking a creative 3D Product Modeler & Rendering Artist to transform technical CAD drawings and design concepts into high-precision 3D models and photorealistic visuals for our product catalog, website, and marketing channels.



Key Responsibilities



3D Modeling : Build high-precision 3D models of cabinets, hardware components, and custom architectural fixtures using CAD data, 2D blueprints, or technical specifications.



Photorealistic Rendering : Create studio product renders, CMF (Color, Material, Finish) options, and full architectural lifestyle scenes (kitchens, bathrooms, storage spaces) for e-commerce, advertising, and client presentations.



Texturing & Lighting: Develop realistic wood grains, marble, metals, and composite materials using PBR workflows; establish realistic natural and artificial lighting setups.



Post-Processing: Touch up, color-correct, and composite rendered images using Photoshop or similar tools for final publication.



Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with our interior designers, product developers, and marketing teams to ensure visually cohesive assets that align with brand standards.



Qualifications & Requirements



Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing high-end product renders, detailed cabinet/furniture modeling, and interior scene visualizations (wireframe or breakdown shots preferred).



Software Proficiency:



3D & Rendering: Blender, 3ds Max, Maya, Rhino, KeyShot, V-Ray, Corona, or Cinema 4D.



Texturing & Editing: Substance Painter, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator.



CAD Integration: Experience importing and optimizing CAD formats (e.g., STEP, IGES, DWG) for rendering workflows.



Technical Skills: Sound knowledge of scale, proportion, material physics, topology, and spatial lighting composition.



Language: Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal).



Nice-to-Haves



Experience in cabinet manufacturing, millwork, architectural visualization (ArchViz), or interior design.



Ability to create 360-degree interactive product views or short 3D walkthrough animations.



What We Offer

Flexible working environment (remote or hybrid options available).



Collaborative team atmosphere with direct impact on key customer touchpoints.

title: Senior Video Editor — Long-Form + Short-Form | High Output & Fast Turnaround
description:
Senior Video Editor — Long-Form + Short-Form | High Output & Fast Turnaround



We are looking for an experienced, highly creative, FAST video editor to join our team for ongoing video production.



This is not an entry-level editing position.



We produce a high volume of video content and need an editor who can take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging content quickly — without needing to be micromanaged on every cut, transition, sound effect, hook or creative decision.



You must be comfortable working with both:

* Long-form YouTube and podcast-style content

* Short-form Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head videos

* Educational and marketing content

* Interviews and podcasts

* Promotional/social media content



What We Care About Most:



1. SPEED

We operate at a high production cadence.

You must be able to edit quickly while maintaining quality.

We do not want an editor who needs three days to produce something that a great editor can complete in several hours.



Turnaround time matters.

2. CREATIVE JUDGMENT

We don't want to tell you where to make every cut.



You should understand:

* Hooks

* Pacing

* Pattern interrupts

* B-roll

* Punch-ins

* Text and captions

* Music

* Sound effects

* Storytelling

* Retention editing

* Humor when appropriate

* When NOT to over-edit



You should be able to watch raw footage and immediately begin seeing opportunities to make the finished video better.

3. SHORT-FORM CONTENT



You must understand modern short-form editing.

We want someone who can take a longer piece of content and identify the moments that can become compelling standalone short-form videos.



That means understanding the idea and hook, not simply cutting a 60-second section from a long video.



4. RELIABILITY



We cannot have production stop because:



"My internet went down."

"The electricity went out."

"My computer crashed."



You must have reliable equipment and contingency plans.



Computer Requirements



We strongly prefer editors working on a MacBook Pro with Apple Silicon, although high-performance Windows editing workstations will also be considered.

Preferred specifications:

Mac

* MacBook Pro

* Apple Silicon M1 Pro or newer

* 316 GB RAM Min or more preferred

* SSD storage



Windows

* Modern Intel i7/i9 or AMD Ryzen 7/9

* 16 GB RAM min or more

* Dedicated GPU suitable for professional video editing

* SSD/NVMe storage



Your computer must comfortably handle professional HD and 4K editing without constantly relying on extremely slow renders.



Internet Requirements



You must have:

Primary high-speed internet

* Minimum target: 100 Mbps download

* Minimum target: 50 Mbps upload

AND

A separate backup internet connection.



Your backup can be:

* Secondary ISP

* 5G/LTE hotspot

* Dedicated mobile internet solution



"I can use my neighbor's Wi-Fi" is not considered backup internet.



Backup Power Is Required

You must have a legitimate backup power solution that allows you to continue working during a power outage.



Examples include:

* UPS

* Portable power station

* Generator

* Laptop + high-capacity power solution



Your backup should also keep your modem/router or backup internet system operating.



Software



You should be highly proficient with professional editing software such as:

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut 



Experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Audition and other creative tools is a major advantage.

AI-assisted editing tools and workflows are also a plus.



How To Apply: 



Do NOT send us a generic application.



Start your application with:



FAST EDITOR

Then provide the following:

1. Your best work



Send links to:

* 3 long-form videos you personally edited

* 5 short-form videos you personally edited

Tell us exactly what you were responsible for on each project.



2. Computer Screenshot

Send a screenshot showing your:

* Computer model

* Processor/CPU

* Operating system

* Installed RAM

* GPU, if applicable

* Available storage



Mac users can send a screenshot of About This Mac / System Information.



Windows users should send screenshots showing System Information and Task Manager → Performance.



3. Computer Photo

Send an actual photo of the computer/workstation you currently use.



4. Internet Speed

Send a CURRENT Speedtest screenshot showing:

* Ping

* Download speed

* Upload speed

5. Backup Internet



Send a photo of your backup internet equipment or hotspot and explain what you use.

If possible, also provide a Speedtest screenshot using your backup connection.



6. Backup Power

Send a photo of your UPS, power station, generator or other backup power system.

Tell us approximately how many hours you can continue working during a power outage.



7. Editing Software

Tell us which programs you use and rate your proficiency from 1–10 for each.



8. Editing Speed

Tell us approximately how long it would take you to edit:

* One 10-minute talking-head YouTube video

* One 60-minute podcast/interview

* Five 30–60 second short-form videos



Be realistic. You may be tested on this.



Finalists



Selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid editing test using the same raw footage.



We will evaluate:

Quality + Creativity + Speed + Ability to Follow Instructions

A beautiful edit delivered too slowly will not beat an excellent edit delivered quickly.

We're looking for someone who wants consistent work, can handle a serious production schedule, communicates well, takes ownership of their work and wants to become an important part of our content team.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Position: Appointment Setter / Intake Specialist

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Pacific Time (U.S.)

Philippine Time: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (PHT)

Industry: Legal Services / Consumer Protection



About Us



We are a fast-growing U.S. law firm dedicated to helping consumers resolve issues with defective vehicles. Our team is focused on delivering excellent client service, strong communication, and efficient case intake support.



We are looking for a motivated and confident Appointment Setter / Intake Specialist to cover our U.S. Pacific Time night shift. This role will focus on making outbound calls to potential clients, building trust quickly, qualifying leads, scheduling consultations, and helping convert qualified leads into retained clients.



Responsibilities

Make outbound calls to prospective clients who submitted inquiries or showed interest in lemon law representation

Explain the firm’s services clearly and professionally

Qualify leads based on vehicle and case information

Build rapport and maintain a consultative, empathetic approach during calls

Follow up consistently with warm leads via phone, text, and

Schedule consultations and assist with client onboarding

Gather and accurately enter client information into the CRM/case management system

Maintain detailed call notes and track follow-up activities

Meet daily and weekly call and conversion goals

Collaborate with attorneys and intake staff to ensure a smooth handoff of retained clients

Monitor and respond to leads during the assigned shift

Maintain consistent follow-up on leads that have not yet retained

Qualifications

Previous experience in appointment setting, intake, sales, telemarketing, or customer service

Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written

Comfortable making high-volume outbound calls

Confident, persuasive, and professional phone presence

Ability to handle objections and maintain a positive attitude

Strong organizational and follow-up skills

Experience using CRMs, dialers, or case management software is preferred

Legal intake or lemon law experience is a plus, but not required

Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment

Must be available to work 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Pacific Time / 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Philippine Time

Preferred Skills

Experience in personal injury, lemon law, or legal intake

Understanding of California lemon law basics

Sales and retention mindset

Strong follow-up and lead-conversion skills

Ability to multitask and work independently in a remote environment

Comfortable working with U.S.-based clients

Compensation

Competitive hourly pay based on experience

Performance-based bonuses and incentives

Growth opportunities within the firm

What Success Looks Like

Consistently contacting and following up with leads

Quickly responding to new leads during the assigned shift

Converting qualified prospects into retained clients

Providing a professional and supportive client experience

Maintaining accurate CRM records and call notes

Helping the firm maintain strong intake and retention numbers

How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume

A short voice recording or introduction

Your experience with outbound calling, appointment setting, or legal intake

Your expected compensation

2 references with active contact information

If currently employed, you must be able to show proof of contract termination



Applicants with strong English communication skills, outbound sales experience, and a proven ability to convert leads are highly encouraged to apply.



Important: This is a full-time Philippine-based position covering U.S. Pacific Time hours, from 9:00 PM–5:00 AM PST (12:00 PM–8:00 PM Philippine Time).

title: Accounting Manager — Month-End Close & Job Costing (US Construction, Night Shift)
description:
Republic Homebuilding and Renovations is a design-build residential

construction and remodeling firm in Webster, Texas, USA, serving

homeowners across the Greater Houston area. We run about ten active

jobs at a time, ranging from $20,000 to $300,000. We use QuickBooks

Online for accounting and JobTread for project management and job

costing.

 

We are hiring one Accounting Manager. This is a fully remote role for

someone based in the Philippines, working United States Central Time

hours.

 

 

READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

 

We would rather you rule yourself out now than at offer stage.

 

- This is a night shift, permanently. 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine

  time, Monday to Friday, with one hour unpaid lunch.

- This is a direct engagement with a US company. You would work as an

  independent contractor, not as an employee under Philippine labor

  law. You are responsible for your own taxes and government

  contributions.

- We do NOT provide SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, or HMO. Our pay is set

  above the local market rate specifically because of this. Please

  factor it into your decision.

- This is exclusive and full time. You may not hold another job or

  client engagement while working with us. You will be asked to list

  every current engagement in your application.

- We use screenshot monitoring software on work computers.

 

Pay is $9.00 to $12.00 per hour depending on experience, 40 hours per

week. At today's rate that is roughly PHP 95,700 to PHP 127,500 per

month. Because pay is in US dollars, the peso value moves with the

exchange rate. We also pay a year-end bonus equal to one month's pay,

prorated by month of hire.

 

 

THIS IS NOT A DATA-ENTRY JOB

 

You will own the accounting function.

 

We have separate staff who enter bills, send invoices, chase

documents, and track purchase orders. Your job is to own the close,

own the reconciliations, own the job cost data, and review their work

- not to do it yourself.

 

We are also going to be straightforward about something most job posts

leave out: our historical books need cleanup. Costs have not been

consistently coded to the right jobs, and some accounts need to be

reorganized. Your first ninety days include a defined cleanup project

alongside normal monthly work. You will not be inheriting a clean

system and we are not pretending otherwise.

 

If that is the kind of problem you enjoy, we want to hear from you. If

it sounds like a headache, this is not the right role for you, and

that is fine.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS - ALL FOUR ARE REQUIRED

 

- Bachelor's degree in Accountancy

- 3+ years of accounting experience, including at least one year where

  you were personally responsible for closing the books every month.

  Not assisting someone else who closed them.

- Experience assigning costs to specific projects or jobs, including

  d
 which job a cost belongs to at the time you record it

- QuickBooks Online experience

 

 

STRONGLY PREFERRED

 

- Construction, remodeling, or contracting experience, especially US

  residential

- Experience with a project management or job-costing system alongside

  the accounting system (JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore, CoConstruct,

  or similar)

- Experience producing a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule using

  percentage-of-completion

- Experience closing books for more than one related entity, including

  intercompany transactions

- QuickBooks Online Advanced Certification / ProAdvisor

- CPA (PRC) license

 

If you do not have every item on the preferred list, apply anyway. The

four requirements above are what matter.

 

 

WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS

 

- Reliable high-speed internet AND a reliable backup connection

- Backup power supply

- Reliable computer plus a backup device

- Willingness to use screenshot monitoring software

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 

Monthly close

- Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts every month

- Produce the monthly financial package: profit and loss, balance

  sheet, cash flow statement

- Produce a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule

- Prepare monthly reporting packages required by outside parties

- Close on a published schedule, not "when it gets done"

 

Job costing

- Ensure every cost is coded to the correct job and correct cost type

  at the time it is recorded

- Maintain a clean separation between job costs and company overhead,

  and apply it consistently

- Reconcile job cost data in QuickBooks against JobTread and resolve

  the differences

- Produce per-job cost reporting the project team can rely on

 

Bank feed and payables

- You are the only person who touches the bank feed. Bank feed items

  must be matched to existing bills before they are categorized, never

  entered as new expenses when a bill already exists

- Maintain accounts payable and review vendor bills entered by admin

  staff

- Weekly review for duplicate or miscoded transactions

 

Other

- Run payroll and maintain payroll records

- Maintain the chart of accounts. You are the only person who may add

  or change an account

- Review the work of the admin staff who enter bills and prepare

  invoices

- Reconciliation work extends to two affiliated partnerships in

  addition to the main company

 

 

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 

We measure this role on deliverables, not on time served.

 

- By Day 21: a written month-end close procedure, in your own words,

  that someone else could follow

- By Day 45: first complete set of reconciliations across all bank,

  credit card, and loan accounts

- By Day 75: first complete monthly financial package, delivered on

  schedule

- By Day 90: agreed cleanup milestones met, and job cost data usable

  for estimating

 

 

WHY YOU WILL LIKE WORKING HERE

 

- Real ownership. You are the accounting function, not a task-taker

- A defined problem with a defined finish line, and a company that

  already knows what is broken

- Admin support, so you are not buried in data entry

- Clear hours, clear expectations, deliverables you can point to

- Direct access to the company President. No layers

- Genuine US construction accounting experience: job costing, WIP,

  percentage-of-completion

 

 

OUR HIRING PROCESS

 

1. Application review

2. Short introductory video call

3. Paid two-hour work sample - a real reconciliation and job-costing

   exercise. We pay you at the role's hourly rate for your time

   whether or not we make an offer. Finalists only.

4. Reference check with a direct supervisor from a recent role

5. Offer

 

We do this because we would rather see how you work than hear about

it.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY - FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY

 

Please apply at our consolidated application form located here: 



Mark

title: Off-Page SEO Specialist — Local Link Building Expert (US Moving Industry Clients)
description:
# Off-Page SEO Specialist — Local Link Building Expert (US Moving Industry Clients)



**Pay:** $1,200/month to start — *negotiable, and we'll pay more for the right person with a proven local link building portfolio*

**Hours:** Full-time, 40 hrs/week (adjust to your preferred schedule/timezone overlap required)

**Type:** Long-term, ongoing — this is not a project-based gig



---



About Us



Moving Engine is a digital marketing agency built exclusively for moving companies. We run SEO, paid ads, and lead management for a portfolio of moving company clients across the US, backed by our own in-house CRM/lead platform. Our SEO team is growing, and we need a specialist who can own **off-page SEO** — with local backlink acquisition as the #1 priority skill.



The Role



We're not looking for a generalist. We're looking for someone who genuinely knows how to **earn real local backlinks** — not buy links from a DA/DR marketplace, not blast guest posts, but build authentic, geographically-relevant links the way a skilled local SEO practitioner does it. Everything else on this list matters, but local link acquisition is the single most important skill we're hiring for, and we will pay a premium for someone who's exceptional at it.



What You'll Do



- **Local backlink acquisition (top priority):** Identify and secure genuine, geo-relevant backlinks — local business associations, Chambers of Commerce, industry directories, sponsorships, local news/blogs, and other white-hat local link opportunities. Manual outreach and relationship-building, not automated blasts.

- **Citations management:** Build and maintain accurate, consistent citations across business directories using BrightLocal, ensuring NAP (Name/Address/Phone) consistency across every client.

- **Backlink audits & tracking:** Use SE Ranking and backlink analysis tools to audit client backlink profiles, monitor competitor link building, track rankings, and identify toxic/spammy links to disavow.

- **Off-page strategy & reporting:** Build monthly off-page SEO plans per client, track link acquisition progress, and report on ranking impact.

- **Directory & business listing management:** Submit and maintain listings across relevant business directories beyond core citation platforms.



Requirements



- **Minimum 5 years of hands-on SEO experience**, with a clear specialization in **off-page SEO / local link building** — not just general on-page or technical SEO

- **Proven, demonstrable experience acquiring real local backlinks manually** — you must be able to show past examples/case studies of links you personally built and the results they drove (this is the #1 thing we're screening for)

- Skilled with **SE Ranking**, **BrightLocal**, backlink analysis tools, and citation/business directory processes

- Strong understanding of local SEO ranking factors — citations, NAP consistency, local link signals, Google Business Profile impact on off-page work

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable managing off-page SEO across a portfolio of 10–15+ client websites at once

- Self-directed — able to run outreach campaigns and manage relationships without hand-holding

- **Big plus:** experience with home services, local service businesses, or moving/relocation industry SEO



Compensation & Growth



- Starting pay: **$1,200/month**

- We are explicitly willing to pay more than this for a candidate who can prove exceptional local link building results — tell us in your application if this applies to you

- Long-term role with a growing agency, room to take on more scope as you prove out results



How to Apply



To be considered, please submit:



1. A short summary of your local link building process — how do you find and secure local links manually?

2. 2–3 real examples of local backlinks you've personally built (client name can be withheld, but show the link, the outreach method, and the outcome)

3. Your experience with SE Ranking and BrightLocal specifically

4. Your available start date and monthly rate expectation



**Important:** To confirm you've read this whole post, please start your application with the phrase **"Local Link Ninja"** in the subject line. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

description:

We are three Dutch entrepreneurs in our twenties, with over 10 years of combined e-commerce experience between us. We each own a specific part of the business — and we came together because we saw an opportunity to build something serious.



We run a US-based Shopify fashion dropshipping store with a specific concept and niche. We are multi-platform — running active paid campaigns on Google,
, and Pinterest simultaneously. With Q4 coming, we are pushing hard to extract every bit of growth this store has to offer.



We already have a team — two part-timers and multiple Filipino team members. We know how to work remotely, we know how to train people, and we know how to grow with people who are willing to grow with us.



THE TEAM CULTURE



We communicate via Slack. That is our office. We expect fast replies — not because we micromanage, but because we are a team that moves quickly and needs to stay aligned. Being reachable and responsive on Slack is non-negotiable.



You will be joining a warm, driven team. Everyone here is motivated to improve themselves, not just complete tasks. We are not looking for someone who clocks in and clocks out. We want someone who takes pride in their work and wants to get better every week.



If that sounds like you — keep reading.



THE ROLE



You will own a core part of our backend operations. This is not a passive assistant role. We expect you to work independently, follow our SOPs and Loom training videos, and flag issues before they become problems.



You will receive full training through detailed Loom videos and written SOPs. Our AI tools handle the heavy lifting — your job is to operate them accurately, check the output, and maintain our quality standard.



YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Perform daily quality checks on the Shopify store using our provided checklist — thoroughly and independently

List 5 new product collections per day using our AI tools — accuracy and speed both matter

Every other day: add and verify size charts for all collections based on updated supplier data

Cross-check size charts against supplier specifications and correct or flag any discrepancies immediately

Maintain clean and accurate product backends — titles, descriptions, sizes, and images must all meet our standards

Communicate proactively on Slack when something is unclear or incorrect — do not guess, do not delay



WORKING DAYS & AVAILABILITY



We work Monday through Saturday. You are expected to be available and reachable on Slack on Saturdays as well. This is a remote role, but availability during working days is required — we are a team, not a group of freelancers working in isolation.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



Proven Shopify experience — this is mandatory, no exceptions

Strong written English — all team communication is in English

Available Monday through Saturday, including reachable on Saturdays via Slack

Reliable high-speed internet (speedtest screenshot required when applying)

Own laptop or desktop with a working camera

Comfortable with Slack and async remote communication

Ability to follow SOPs and Loom video training independently

AI tool experience is a plus — we will train you on our specific systems



COMPENSATION & GROWTH PATH



Starting rate: $4.00/hour (discussable) | 15–30 hours/week | Part-time to Full-time



Every new team member starts at our base rate during the onboarding period. This is a 4-week onboarding phase, after which we review performance and adjust compensation accordingly.



We do not keep good people at a low rate. If you deliver quality work and grow into the role, your hours and rate will increase. Our best team members move to full-time. We reward results and loyalty — not just presence.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us the following — keep it concise and direct:



A short introduction (3–5 sentences max — no generic copy-paste, tell us who you actually are)

Proof of Shopify experience: screenshots, a portfolio link, or a reference from a previous employer

Your weekly availability in hours and your working days

A speedtest.net screenshot showing your internet speed

Add the word 'black' in your application

## WHAT WE REQUIRE



**Previous U.S. freight dispatch experience is required.**



You should already understand:



* DAT and/or Truckstop

* Rate negotiation

* RPM / rate per mile

* Deadhead calculations

* Profitable U.S. freight lanes

* Rate confirmations

* Reliable computer

* Quiet professional workspace

* Ability to work **U.S. Eastern Time**

* Ability to manage multiple trucks without losing track of loads

* Strong organization and attention to detail

* Ability to work independently



## COMPENSATION



This is a **commission-based independent contractor position.**



**Starting commission: 2%**



Dispatchers may earn **up to 4�sed on performance, experience, and the number of trucks successfully managed.**



Performance will be evaluated using:



* Weekly gross revenue per truck

* Rate per mile

* Deadhead percentage

* Quality of loads booked

* Broker negotiation

* Communication

* Accuracy

* Carrier satisfaction and retention

* Ability to manage multiple trucks



**The better the trucks perform, the more opportunity you have to earn.**



We are building a long-term dispatch operation, so strong performers will have opportunities to manage additional trucks and take on greater responsibility as the company grows.



## DO NOT APPLY IF:



* You have never dispatched U.S. freight

* You have never used a U.S. load board

* You are uncomfortable calling brokers

* You cannot negotiate rates

* You are looking for a job you can quietly stack with several other full-time positions

### REQUIRED VOICE RECORDING

Applications without the requested information or voice recording may not be considered.



**We are looking for experienced dispatchers who know how to negotiate, think ahead, protect the carrier's profitability, and grow with Allen Freight & Logistics LLC.**

title: Experimentation Analyst (Part-Time - Split Testing & Data Quality)
description:
Do you have experience running and analyzing A/B or multivariate tests?



Are you fluent in Google Sheets or Excel — pivot tables, cohort tables, charts?



Do you understand statistical significance, sample size, and how to tell when a test is actually finished?



Do you actively push work forward instead of waiting to be told what to do next?



If yes to all four, you might be a great fit for this role.



We run ongoing split tests across our marketing funnels — testing different videos, headlines, page designs, and subscription routes to see what sells best. We need one careful, proactive person to own the system that keeps every test honest, organized, and moving.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



- Own the system of record for split tests. We already have a foundation — you'll take it over, build on it, and keep it sharp: one clear place that shows every test across every brand and where each one stands.

- Protect the data integrity of every split test. Set tests up so errors can't creep in, and on the rare occasion something slips through — a mismatched time window, a cherry-picked group, a wrong denominator — catch it before it reaches a decision.

- Make results easy to act on. Present each test so the winner, the margin, and the takeaway are clear at a glance — and make sure what we learn is captured where the team will actually use it, so no lesson gets lost.

- Reconcile the numbers. When two reports disagree on the same figure, find out which one is right and why, and write it down clearly so no one has to work it out again.

- Keep every new test set up right before it goes live — variables clearly identified, the success metric agreed up front, and the sample size worked out in advance.

- Stay on top of every running test and surface when it has enough data to call, so a winner is never picked too early.

- Push the pipeline forward. Keep test slots full, rank the backlog by leverage, and look ahead at what upcoming tests will need (tech setup, design assets, copy) so nothing stalls waiting on a dependency.



THE TOOLS



Day to day you'll work in spreadsheets and a handful of analytics and database tools — including Google Analytics (GA4), 
, HasOffers/TUNE, BigQuery, and a custom dashboard of our own. We'll get you up to speed on our specific setup; you bring the fundamentals.



We use AI tools in our own work, and you're welcome to use them here. What we care about is the judgment you bring on top of them. If you reach the paid test project, we'll ask which tools you used, AI included, and for the conversation logs.



YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU ARE



- Fluent in Google Sheets or Excel (pivot tables, cohort tables, charts).

- Comfortable with statistical hypothesis testing, significance, and sample-size estimation.

- Able to explain "why this test isn't done yet" to someone who isn't a statistician.

- Detail-oriented and organized — you don't let numbers slip through.

- Comfortable learning SQL, BI tools, or experimentation platforms.

- Someone who actively manages and pushes the work forward — keeps tests moving and flags what's next without waiting to be told.



TO APPLY



If you've read this far and think you'd be a great fit, reply with:



1. Why you're a strong match for this role.

2. Your favorite movie (so I know you read all the way to the end).



Qualified applicants will receive a short screening question, then a paid test project, then interviews with the hiring manager. One person will be chosen for the ongoing role after the trial.



This is a part-time contract: 10–20 hours per week, ongoing. Pay is $10–$15/hour, up to $18/hour for the right person.



This role requires you to track your hours with Time Doctor, which takes periodic screenshots of your screen while you work. If that is not comfortable for you, this is not the right fit.

title: GoHighLevel form + workflow build
description:
GoHighLevel form + workflow build — 61 forms, full spec provided (paid, fixed price)



I run a flat-fee MLS listing brokerage in Texas and I need someone who actually knows the GHL form builder to implement a build that's already fully specced.



Everything is documented. A spreadsheet defines every question, its field type, its dropdown options, whether it's required, and its conditional rule. You'd be implementing, not designing — no discovery calls, no "what do you want it to look like."



The work



Verify roughly 202 contact custom fields (created by script; you check them and fix any that failed)

Build three base forms: Residential intake (33 questions), Land & Acreage (29), Showing Instructions (23)

Add conditional logic — HOA questions only when there's an HOA, lease questions only when tenant-occupied, etc. The rules are specified

Duplicate the Residential form four times for different MLS boards, adding 8–23 extra fields to each from a supplied list

Build workflows: Form Submitted → set fields, move the opportunity to the right pipeline stage, create a task

Test each form with a live submission and confirm every value lands on the contact record



Roughly 12–18 hours of careful work. Fixed price — tell me your number.



What I need from you



Real GoHighLevel experience with forms, workflows, custom fields and conditional logic.



And the discipline to follow a spec exactly. Field names lock after the first save, and eleven variants inherit whatever you type, so wording has to match the spreadsheet verbatim — no improving it, no shortening it.



Real estate or 
 experience is a bonus, not a requirement.



How this runs



I'll award the Land & Acreage form first as a paid milestone. It's self-contained and it tells us both whether we work well together. If it comes back right, you get the rest on the same terms.



You'll have a limited user account, not owner access, and no API tokens. The account holds real seller information, so I'll need a confidentiality agreement signed before access.



To apply, answer these three



In the GoHighLevel form builder — what's the difference between Quick Add and Add Object Fields, and which do you use to place a field that already exists?

Send a 2-minute Loom walking through a GoHighLevel workflow you personally built.

How long would the three base forms and their conditional logic take you?



Please don't send a template proposal. I'll only reply to people who answer the three questions.

title: Video Editor – Short-Form Ads | Hiring 10 Editors (Base + Performance Bonuses)
description:
We are hiring 10 short-form video editors. Not one. Ten.



We are a fast growing e-commerce group with our own DTC brands across Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, the UK and more. Our ads reach over 100 million people every month, and we launch a new product almost every day. Video is our bottleneck, so we are building a team that runs seven days a week.



Because we are hiring ten, this is not a lottery where one person wins. Show a real portfolio, follow the onboarding, deliver in your first week, and you are in. Most people who do not make it here fail by ignoring instructions, not on talent.



WHAT YOU EARN



$200 USD per month base, guaranteed, paid weekly through PayPal.



Plus $25 for every ad of yours that reaches 10,000 SEK (about $900) in ad spend while holding a ROAS above 3.0.



Maximum $400 per month. We tell you the ceiling openly, because we do not promise numbers we will not pay.



HOW THE BONUS WORKS



Every ad you make is tracked. When one hits 10,000 SEK in spend and is still above 3.0 ROAS, that is a winner and you get $25. We check three days later, so late conversions count in your favour. Once earned it is yours, even if the ad fades afterwards. One bonus per ad.



WHERE THIS GOES



This role is the entry, not the ceiling.



Perform as an individual - real editing skill, how well you absorb instructions, how fast you work - and you get upgraded to our experienced editors.



At that level you get a personal creative strategist, and together you build brands and scale them into the millions. You also get a share of that brand's profit.



That is where the real money is made, and it is why we care more about how you think than how fast you cut.



THE WORK



You are not building ads from scratch. You take proven formats that already work and adapt them fast for our products. References, hooks and briefs are prepared for you.



Daily: work through your queue, produce one adapted version per brand, adapt voiceover, captions, hook and pacing, upload and mark done, stay responsive in the group chat.



OUR NUMBER ONE RULE



What the voiceover says must match what is on screen. If the voice says my ears are hurting, the viewer sees someone in pain in the ear. Editors who ignore this do not last here.



WHAT WE NEED



Solid short-form editing (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci or similar)

Comfortable with AI tools (ElevenLabs, ChatGPT)

Good English, fast communication

Clean spelling, clean cuts, no watermarks

Full-time availability

Applies feedback immediately



WHAT ELSE YOU GET



A professional video editing course worth over $9,000 USD, paid for by us and yours to keep.



Every tool paid for. Using AI to work faster is encouraged here, not frowned upon.



WHAT IT IS ACTUALLY LIKE TO WORK HERE



We will be honest with you. We think this will be the best job you have ever had, and we do not say that lightly.



We are far more like a family than a strict team. Everyone here is helpful, caring and friendly, and people genuinely look out for each other. Ask anything, as many times as you need. Nobody is precious about titles, and nobody is ever made to feel small for getting something wrong. If you make a mistake we tell you what to fix, you fix it, and we move on. That is the whole drama.



Most of our team are Filipino, so you will not be the odd one out. You will be joining people who already know how we work and who will help you settle in.



You will not be micromanaged, and you will never have to wonder where you stand with us, because when you do something good we say it out loud, in front of everyone.



That is what a workplace should feel like, and it is the part we are most proud of. Our editors tell us it is the most fun they have ever had at work.



Come and build something with us. We do not think you will regret it.



HOW TO APPLY



No generic applications, we delete those. Send us:



A short intro

Your portfolio, or 2-3 short-form ads you have edited

What is one short-form ad you saw recently that was really well made, and why?

Your WhatsApp number



We reply to everyone who does all four. Ten seats, filling fast.

title: LEGAL ASSISTANT TO A PRE-LITIGATION CASE MANAGER - US LAW FIRM (NIGHT SHIFT)

Read this entire posting before applying. Applications that skip the instructions at the bottom are deleted without review.



I'm Hunter Garnett, a personal injury lawyer and the owner of Garnett Patterson Injury Lawyers in Huntsville, Alabama. We represent people who've been hurt in a
, usually at the worst moment of their lives, and our stated goal is to deliver the best client service of any injury firm in the country. Our tagline is "Helping Good People After a Bad A
." We mean the good people part, and that includes the people who work here.



We are hiring one Legal Assistant to support a single Pre-Litigation Case Manager.



The case manager you will support was recently promoted into the role from inside our firm, and his caseload is growing. He needs someone strong beside him - not someone who waits to be told what to do next. This is a real opportunity to help build a pod from the ground up, and the person who does it well will grow with it.



WHAT THIS JOB IS



You are the support behind one case manager. He owns the files. You keep them moving.



- Set up new cases in Filevine - client details, providers, insurance, deadlines

- Request medical records and bills from US providers, then chase them until they arrive

- Organize records and bills so they are complete, in order, and ready for a demand

- Send letters of representation and letters of acknowledgment to insurance carriers

- Open claims and confirm coverage with adjusters

- Prepare routine correspondence to clients, providers, and carriers

- Answer and route calls from clients and providers professionally

- Keep case notes current so nothing is lost between people

- Follow up on outstanding items so deadlines never slip



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT



This is not a case manager role. You will not carry your own caseload, negotiate liens, or run settlements. If you are currently a case manager earning $10-$12 per hour, this is a step down in both pay and scope, and we will not be able to match your current rate. Please do not apply hoping we will.



HARD REQUIREMENTS - you must meet all of these



- WE WILL BE YOUR ONLY EMPLOYER. No other clients, no other part-time work, no   freelancing on the side. If you are currently working for another client and intend to keep them, do not apply.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will speak directly with American clients, medical providers, and insurance adjusters every day.

- Able to work 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila time, Monday through Friday, consistently and long-term.

- YOUR ONLINEJOBS.PH PROFILE MUST SHOW YOUR POSTED IQ SCORE, YOUR DISC PROFILE, AND YOUR ENGLISH PROFICIENCY TEST RESULT. We will not review applications from profiles missing these. If you have not taken them, take them first, then apply.

- Your own computer, reliable internet with backup, and a quiet workspace with no background noise on calls.

- Comfortable learning new software. We use Filevine, Microsoft 365, RingCentral, and Time Doctor.

- You show up. Every shift, on time, without being asked twice.



DO NOT APPLY IF

- You want part-time, project work, or a second income

- You cannot work overnight Manila hours

- You need to keep an existing client

- You have not taken the OnlineJobs.ph tests

- You are looking for a case manager or paralegal role



HELPFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED

- Spanish, written or spoken

- Prior support work for a US law firm, medical practice, or insurance company

- Experience requesting or organizing US medical records

- Familiarity with Filevine



WHY WORK WITH US

- Stable, long-term, full-time work with one US firm

- Hired and paid through WorkWise Solutions - reliable, on time, every time

- Paid time off and holidays

- You are part of our team, not a hidden VA. You will be on our calls and know our clients by name.

- We promote from within. Our case managers started where you are starting.

- Work that matters - real people, in a hard season, who need someone paying attention



HOW TO APPLY



APPLY THROUGH THE APPLY BUTTON ON THIS ONLINEJOBS.PH POSTING. DO NOT
 US.

ED APPLICATIONS ARE DELETED UNREAD.



Your application must include all four items below. Missing any one of them removes you from consideration.



1. Begin your application with the word CEDAR GATE so we know you read this posting completely.



2. Your resume.



3. Written confirmation, in your own words, that Garnett Patterson Injury Lawyers would be your only employer and that you have no other clients you intend to keep.



4. Short answers, in English, to these three questions. Two to four sentences each - we would rather read something true and short than something long and polished:
