title: Google Ads Specialist for 8 Figure DTC Brand
description:
AZ Marketing, an E-Commerce Google Ads agency is looking for a part-time specialist to join their team.



Primary job: creating static advertisements (image ads) & writing copy. Building exclusive Performance Max image and video ad campaigns with no focus on shopping or search. Testing new product angles, audiences and creatives.



AZ Marketing is a specialized e-commerce Google Ads agency serving cash-on-delivery brands across European markets. We build creative-led Performance Max campaigns focused almost entirely on image and video advertising—without Shopping feeds and with no emphasis on traditional Search campaigns.



We are looking for a part-time Google Ads Specialist for an 8 Figure DTC Brand to join our team in a long-term remote position.



About the role:



Your primary responsibility will be creating static advertisements using AI tools and writing compelling advertising copy. You will also build and manage Performance Max campaigns using image and video assets.



You will continuously test new product angles, audiences, advertising messages and creative concepts to identify what generates the best results.



Our campaign structure and optimization process are different from those used by most Google Ads agencies. You do not need experience with our exact approach. However, you should already have a solid understanding of Google Ads and digital advertising.



This role does not focus on Google Shopping, Merchant Center feeds or traditional Search campaign management.



Your responsibilities:



Research products, target customers, competitors and market opportunities.

Identify new marketing angles and customer use cases.

Develop creative concepts for static image advertisements.

Create high-quality image ads using AI image-generation and design tools.

Write headlines, descriptions and other advertising copy.

Build Performance Max campaigns and asset groups using image and video assets.

Launch campaigns across multiple European countries.

Adapt advertising concepts and copy for different languages and markets.

Test different product angles, audiences, messages and creatives.

Monitor campaign and creative performance.

Identify underperforming assets and develop new variations.

Prepare clear performance summaries and recommendations.

Follow our campaign-building, optimization and quality-control procedures.

Check campaign settings, budgets, locations, conversion goals, URLs and assets before launch.

Maintain accurate records of campaign changes and creative tests.



What we are looking for:



At least one year of professional experience with Google Ads.

A good understanding of Performance Max campaigns.

Experience creating or managing digital advertising creatives.

Strong written English.

Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to follow documented systems and processes.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Reliable communication and willingness to ask questions.

Strong interest in e-commerce and performance marketing.

Willingness to learn our unique campaign and creative-testing system.



We are looking for someone at a mid-level stage in their career. You do not need to be a senior strategist, but you should understand the fundamentals of Google Ads and be comfortable working inside advertising accounts.



An advantage, but not required:



Experience with e-commerce advertising.

Experience with Performance Max image and video campaigns.

Experience using AI image-generation tools.

Canva, Photoshop or similar design experience.

Advertising copywriting experience.

Experience working with international or European markets.

Experience with cash-on-delivery e-commerce.

Experience adapting advertising materials for multiple languages.



Position details:



● Fully remote.

● 20 hours per week.

● Monday to Friday.

● Long-term position.

● Flexible working schedule with some overlap with Central European working hours.

● Compensation: ₱35,000–₱40,000 per month, depending on experience.

● Salary and responsibility review after the initial three-month trial period.

● Complete training in our internal processes and campaign system.

● Opportunity to increase your responsibilities and compensation as your skill grows.



IMPORTANT: Certain meetings, especially training will be held from three to seven pm GMT+8 local Philippines time



How to apply:



Please begin your application with the words “AZ PMAX” so we know you have read the complete job description.



Include the following information:



A short introduction about yourself.

A description of your Google Ads experience.

The campaign types you have worked with.

Your specific experience with Performance Max.

Examples of image advertisements or creative work you have produced.

A short explanation of a campaign decision you made that improved performance.

Your current availability and preferred working hours.

A short Loom video introducing yourself and explaining your relevant experience.



Please remove or hide all confidential client information from any examples you provide.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and potentially a small practical assignment. The assignment will test your analytical thinking, creative judgment, attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.

title: AI Avatar Builder and Video Editor: HeyGen, CapCut, AI Graphics
description:
THE SCHEDULE



11:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time, Monday through Friday.



Our team works together in Microsoft Teams for that entire window. We are not a company that sends you a task list and disappears. We talk through the work as it happens, so you are expected to be present and reachable on Teams for the whole shift, with meetings and working sessions as they come up.



It is a night shift, the pay reflects it, and we are telling you first rather than burying it at the bottom. These hours are the one thing we cannot be flexible about.



YOU WILL NOT BE THE ONLY ONE AWAKE



The company is US based. The team you work with every night is our established Philippines based night crew, on the same schedule you are, including the manager of our video department. Some of them have been with us for years.



WHAT THIS JOB IS



We are a US digital agency, over 20 years old. We build AI Twins for local business owners: realistic digital doubles of a real person, built from their own footage, photos, and voice, so they can appear in dozens of videos without ever standing in front of a camera. Our clients are real estate agents, dentists, and home service companies who want to become the most trusted name in their town.



We are building an AI based video factory. A real production system, not a content farm. We need one more person to help build it.



The person we want can take a real human being's footage, photos, and voice and turn them into an avatar that is genuinely believable. Then edit that avatar into finished commercials and long form video. Then make the graphics around it look like a studio made them.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Build AI Twins in HeyGen from real people. Natural pacing, clean lip sync, real gestures, matched lighting, a voice that sounds like the actual human being.



Fix avatars that are not working. Know whether the problem is the source footage, the voice model, the script pacing, or the render settings, and then fix it.



Edit in CapCut every day. You will cut client commercials and 8 minute YouTube videos that combine avatar narration with location footage, music, captions, titles, and graphics, finished to the standard a paying client expects. Short form clip experience alone is not enough.



Design in Canva every day. YouTube thumbnails, title cards, lower thirds, social graphics, and ad creative. Generated with AI tools and finished properly so nothing looks raw or machine made.



Grow into automation with us. We run on Claude, Zapier, Google Sheets, and Vendasta. You do not need this on day one. You need to want it, because this is where the role goes.



REQUIRED



HeyGen, including building avatars, not only using ones that already exist.

ElevenLabs.

CapCut. This is our editor and you will be in it daily.

Canva. This is where our graphics get made.

Daily working use of Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini as part of how you actually work.



That is the whole required list. We would rather have someone deep in five tools than someone shallow in fifteen.



HELPS, BUT NOT REQUIRED



Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve.

Zapier, Make, or Google Apps Script.

Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, Sheets, and Trello, which we will teach you if needed.

Experience in real estate, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated industries.



WE PAY FOR THE SOFTWARE



Every account is ours and we provide it. HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut, Canva, all of it. You never buy a subscription to work here.



You provide a computer that can genuinely edit long form video, internet fast enough for it, and a backup plan for power and connection outages, since we are working live together and a mid shift outage stops the whole session.



WHAT WE MEAN BY GOOD



We are not looking for someone who works fast. We are looking for someone who knows these tools so well that they are not fumbling for the setting, and speed happens on its own.



We need someone who sees quality without being told. If the lip sync drifts, if a cut lands a beat early, if a thumbnail reads as generic, catch it and fix it before it reaches anyone else. Bring us the version you are proud of, not the first one that rendered.



WHO THIS IS FOR



Someone genuinely excited by what AI can do right now, who wants to get very good at something new while it is still new, and who wants to do it on a team instead of alone.



This is not freelance work fitted around other clients. During our six hours you are with us. What you do outside that window is your business.



HOURS AND PAY



$7.00 to $9.50 USD per hour, depending on what you can actually do.

6 hours a day to start, Monday through Friday.

Full time at 8 hours a day is available for the right person, and we will tell you honestly where you stand.



HOW HIRING WORKS, AND WE PAY FOR EVERY STEP



Step 1. We read your application.

Step 2. We talk.

Step 3. Paid sample project, for finalists only. $50 USD, due in three days, about three to four hours of work. We send you real footage. You send back an AI Twin, a short edited piece, a thumbnail, and a note on what you would improve with more time.

Step 4. Two week paid trial at your full rate, working the real schedule with the real team on real client work.

Step 5. Long term, with us.



We pay on time, every time. We hire slowly and we keep people for years.



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application that includes all six items. We cannot read the ones that do not, because we get too many.



1. Put the phrase AI TWIN at the very top of your application.

2. Confirm in one line that you can work 11:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time, Monday through Friday.

3. Links to two avatar videos you made. At least one must be an avatar you built yourself from a real person. Tell us what parts were your work.

4. A link to one longer video, three minutes or more, that you personally edited in CapCut.

5. Three graphics you made using AI tools and finished in Canva, and how you got from the first attempt to the final version.

6. Answer in your own words: an AI avatar video reads as fake to a viewer. What are the first three things you check, and in what order?



Then tell us your hourly rate and when you could start.



ONE MORE THING



Apply here through OnlineJobs.ph. Please do not
 us or contact us through our website. Applications that arrive any other way will not be reviewed, and we want everyone considered the same way.

title: Marketing Agency Project Manager – ClickUp, Client Delivery & Operations
description:
HighLevel Mastery is a growing Skool community and digital marketing operation focused on GoHighLevel, automation, websites, advertising, and helping entrepreneurs and service-based businesses grow.



We are looking for an experienced Agency Project Manager to organize our projects, coordinate our team, manage deadlines, and make sure work continues moving forward without the founder having to constantly follow up.



This is a Project Manager role first, but previous experience working with a digital marketing agency or online service business is strongly preferred.



You do not need to be a developer, media buyer, designer, or GoHighLevel expert. However, you should understand digital marketing well enough to effectively manage and communicate with the people doing those jobs.



Our goal is simple:



Nothing should fall through the cracks, and projects should continue moving forward without the founder having to constantly chase the team.



What You'll Be Responsible For

Own and maintain our ClickUp project management system

Turn projects into clear tasks, owners, priorities, and deadlines

Make sure every active project has a clear next step

Monitor deadlines and follow up on overdue or blocked tasks

Coordinate GHL specialists, developers, designers, video editors, media buyers, and other freelancers

Communicate with clients for assets, approvals, credentials, feedback, and project updates

Run short internal project meetings and document next actions

Identify blockers early and proactively work to solve them

Maintain SOPs, checklists, and project documentation

Coordinate QA and approvals before deliverables are completed

Help recruit, screen, and onboard additional contractors and team members when needed

Escalate important decisions to the founder with context and a recommended solution



As our current client projects are completed, this role will also help coordinate HighLevel Master's marketing and community operations, including content production, advertising projects, contractors, hiring, and weekly growth initiatives.



Who We're Looking For



You should have:



Previous Project Manager / Operations experience

Previous experience working with a digital marketing agency or online service business

Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

Experience coordinating remote employees and freelancers

Strong experience with ClickUp or similar project management software

Excellent written and spoken English

Confidence communicating with US-based clients

Strong organization, follow-up, and problem-solving skills

The ability to work independently and take ownership

The ability to hold team members accountable and keep projects moving



GoHighLevel experience is a major plus, but not required.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who closes loops instead of simply reporting problems.



If something is blocked, we expect you to find out why, follow up with the right person, identify possible solutions, and make sure the project starts moving again.



This is not a traditional VA position where you wait for someone to give you your next task. We want someone who can take ownership of the operation and proactively figure out what needs to happen next.



Schedule & Compensation



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position starting at approximately $1,200 USD/month, depending on experience.



Our company operates primarily in the Eastern Time (ET) zone. Consistent availability between approximately 9:00 AM–12:00 PM ET is required. The remainder of your working schedule can be discussed.



This is intended to be a long-term position, with opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility as you grow with the company.



How to Apply



Please send:

- A short summary of your project management experience.

- Tell us about your experience working with a digital marketing agency or online service business.

- Tell us about your experience with ClickUp or other project management software.

- Current Work & Availability: Please be completely honest—are you currently working another job, freelancing, or managing other clients?

 If yes, tell us approximately how many hours per week those commitments require. This is a full-time, 40-hour/week role, and we're looking for someone who can make this their primary professional commitment and give the position their full attention.

- Your expected monthly salary and availability during 9:00 AM–12:00 PM ET.

- Your WhatsApp number: Please include your WhatsApp number with your country code. If we believe you may be a good fit, our team will likely contact you directly through WhatsApp regarding the next step.



IMPORTANT: At the very beginning of your application, write:



“Nothing Falls Through The Cracks.”



Applications without this phrase will not be considered.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Technical Account Engineer (MSP) – Infrastructure, Cloud & Projects
description:
We are seeking a consultative and technically proficient Technical Account Engineer (MSP) to serve as the primary technical advisor and relationship lead for a portfolio of business clients.

 

Are you an ambitious IT professional who loves solving hands-on technical challenges, learning modern cloud and infrastructure stacks, and helping businesses make smart technology decisions? If you have solid IT fundamentals, a strong work ethic, clear communication skills, and a desire to grow into an elite Technical Account Engineer, we want to invest in you.



At Cloudavize, we believe curiosity, logical problem-solving, and trainability matter far more than checking every single technical box. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical engineering and client advocacy, helping design and implement practical infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, and security improvements for our US business clients. We provide dedicated mentorship, hands-on project exposure, and company-sponsored certifications to help you master advanced cloud architectures, security frameworks, and client technical guidance.



What You Will Do

* Technical Guidance & Infrastructure Reviews: Collaborate with client stakeholders and US account teams to review IT environment health, identify potential technical risks, and help plan proactive upgrades.

* Hands-on Implementation & Modernization: Assist with and execute core infrastructure upgrades, including Microsoft 365 migrations, Azure/Microsoft Entra ID configurations, network switch and firewall setups, backup validation, and endpoint security deployments.

* Technical Scoping & Project Planning: Work alongside Project Specialists and Account Managers to assess client infrastructure, evaluate technical dependencies, estimate engineering effort, and draft clear project scopes.

* Standardization & Documentation: Ensure smooth operational handoffs to the service delivery team by building structured network diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures in a documentation platform.

* Continuous Technical Growth: Expand your engineering toolkit through hands-on project execution, cross-training with senior specialists, and structured certification roadmaps.



What We Are Looking For



* Smart & Fast Learner: Strong grasp of core IT fundamentals (Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, DNS, DHCP, and basic networking concepts) and a natural curiosity to explore how things work.

* Trainable & Solutions-Oriented: You do not need to know every technology on day one. We value the drive to research solutions, learn from senior engineers, embrace feedback, and quickly master new systems.

* Clear, Professional Communication: Ability to explain technical setups and project updates clearly and professionally in English, both in written documentation and in conversations with business clients.

* Hands-on Technical Background: 1 to 3+ years in IT support or systems administration (L2 support, junior systems engineer, or technical support specialist), preferably with some exposure to multi-client or MSP environments.

* Ownership & Reliability: Dependable, organized, and focused on delivering clean project cutovers with minimal downtime.

* Schedule & Setup: Comfortable working US business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST / overnight in the Philippines) from a dedicated home office with reliable high-speed internet and power backup.



Nice to Have (Not Required — We Will Train You!)



* Prior experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment or using RMM/PSA tools.

* Hands-on exposure to firewall configurations (Ubiquiti, Cisco, Fortinet), VLANs, VPNs, or tenant-to-tenant migrations.

* Foundational industry certifications (CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals / Azure Administrator, or CCNA).

* Familiarity with centralized documentation platforms.



Why Join Cloudavize?



Work directly with US business leaders and help implement practical, high-impact technology solutions.

* Combine client-facing technical advisory with hands-on infrastructure engineering projects.

* Collaborate with a supportive US and global team of account managers, project specialists, and service delivery engineers.

* Clear career development pathways toward Senior Technical Account Management, Solutions Architecture, or Engineering Leadership.

 

What Sets Us Apart?



* We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally:

* Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

* Continuous Learning: We invest in your professional growth with company-paid certifications and technical training.

* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input, respects your expertise, and supports your success.

* Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of working remotely from home while delivering high-value, impactful projects.

 

How to Apply



If you are a consultative, technically strong IT professional who enjoys leading strategic client conversations and executing modern infrastructure projects, apply now!

1. Subject Line Requirement: Submit your application and include the numbers (2028) in your
 subject line. This helps us ensure you have read the complete job post.

2. Resume/CV: Attach your updated CV with complete tenureship details (or provide a direct link to your CV). Applications submitted without a CV will not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator (Part-Time)
description:
Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator (Part-Time)

Location: Remote

Hours: 20 hours per week, 9:00am–1:00pm (UK Time)

Working arrangement: Part-time



Overview



Our client is a specialist marketing agency supporting agricultural, rural and other service-based businesses. We are looking for a Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator to work alongside the founder and existing marketing team.



This is primarily an implementation and technical delivery role, rather than a marketing strategy, copywriting or graphic design position. The successful candidate will take approved marketing, website and systems requirements and turn them into reliable, functioning digital solutions.



The role will include website implementation, marketing systems, CRM and
 platforms, automations, integrations, analytics and technical troubleshooting across a number of different client accounts. We are looking for someone who is technically confident, organized and able to take ownership of projects without requiring constant direction.



Key Responsibilities



Website Management & Implementation



Update, manage and maintain WordPress websites, primarily using Elementor

Create and edit website pages from supplied briefs, copy and design direction

Build landing pages for campaigns and lead generation

Make responsive adjustments for desktop, tablet and mobile

Upload and format website content

Build and configure website forms

Connect forms with CRM,
 marketing and automation platforms

Manage plugins and perform routine website maintenance

Support staging, website backups and migrations where required

Troubleshoot common WordPress and Elementor issues

Make basic CSS adjustments where appropriate

Support integrations with membership, ecommerce and other third-party systems

Carry out basic domain, DNS, SSL and website hosting troubleshooting where appropriate

Test website functionality before work is considered complete



The role does not require advanced bespoke website development or full-stack development. More complex development requirements may be referred to an external specialist.



Marketing Technology & Automation



Set up and manage
 marketing and CRM systems

Build
 nurture sequences and automated customer journeys

Create and manage automations and workflows

Connect systems using Zapier or comparable integration platforms

Troubleshoot failed automations and integrations

Configure forms, tags, lists, segments and triggers

Test automation journeys before launch

Identify opportunities to improve the reliability or efficiency of existing systems

Document important workflows and integrations so they can be understood and maintained by the wider team



Analytics, Tracking & Digital Systems



Implement and maintain basic website analytics and tracking

Support Google Analytics, Search Console and similar platforms

Implement Meta pixels and other basic marketing tracking requirements

Support Google Business Profile and related digital platforms when required

Carry out basic technical SEO implementation where appropriate

Troubleshoot account connections, permissions and system errors across client marketing platforms



Technical Problem Solving



Investigate and resolve practical technical problems across client systems

Diagnose the likely source of an issue rather than simply following instructions

Research unfamiliar platforms or problems where appropriate

Explain technical issues clearly and simply to non-technical team members and clients

Recognise when an issue requires specialist support and escalate it promptly rather than spending excessive time attempting to solve something outside the scope of the role



Project Management & Working Practices



Strong project management and communication are an important part of this role. The successful candidate will be expected to:



Review requirements before beginning significant pieces of work

Provide realistic estimates of the likely time required where appropriate

Raise concerns if work is likely to exceed the original time estimate

Keep assigned Asana tasks accurate and up to date

Record progress, blockers and next steps clearly

Communicate promptly when access, information or client input is preventing progress

Escalate technical problems early if significant investigation is not producing progress

Work systematically rather than allowing technical troubleshooting to become open-ended

Test and quality-check work before marking tasks as complete

Document important technical changes, integrations and configurations



Examples of quality assurance may include checking: desktop, tablet and mobile website layouts; website links and buttons; forms and submissions; automated
s; CRM records; integrations; tracking; permissions and user journeys.



Essential Skills & Experience



We are more interested in strong technical ability and transferable experience than experience with every specific platform used. Candidates should have:



Strong practical experience with WordPress

Strong working knowledge of Elementor

Experience creating and editing website pages

Experience troubleshooting WordPress websites

Experience with website forms and integrations

Experience using at least one established CRM or
 marketing platform

Experience building
 automations or automated workflows

Experience using Zapier or a comparable integration platform

Basic understanding of website analytics and marketing tracking

Good general understanding of how websites, forms, CRMs,
 systems and third-party platforms connect

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Confidence working independently on project-based tasks

Strong written communication

The ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people



Platforms You May Work With



Existing systems currently include or may include: WordPress, Elementor, MailerLite, Kit, Zoho, Keap, AWeber, Zapier, MemberPress, CloudCampaign, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Meta Business Suite, Asana, Google Workspace.



Experience with every platform listed is not required. Someone with strong transferable technical skills who is confident learning unfamiliar platforms would be considered.



Useful Additional Experience



It would be advantageous to have experience with: membership websites, ecommerce websites, CRM migrations, domain and DNS management, website hosting environments, staging websites and migrations, basic CSS, Meta Business Suite, marketing pixels and conversion tracking, basic technical SEO, supporting several different client accounts simultaneously, and working within a marketing agency or outsourced marketing environment.



Ideal Candidate



The right person is likely to be: technically curious and confident; a practical problem-solver; comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems; able to work independently without becoming isolated; organised and systematic; reliable with deadlines and communication; realistic about how long work will take; comfortable flagging a problem or asking for help early; able to distinguish between productive troubleshooting and spending too much time on an issue; detail-oriented when testing their own work; happy working across several different client systems; able to communicate technical information simply and clearly.



We particularly value someone with a "figure it out, test it and communicate it" mindset.



What This Role Is Not



This role is not primarily responsible for: marketing strategy, copywriting, graphic design, social media content creation, advanced bespoke website development, full-stack development, general diary or inbox management, or general virtual-assistant work. Marketing strategy, copywriting and creative direction are handled elsewhere within the team.



The Technical Marketing & Web Coordinator's primary responsibility is the technical implementation and reliable delivery of approved marketing activity.

title: Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)
description:
Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)

Company: Accommos Ltd (brands: Accommos, Staymodu, Glowhouse Wellness Stays)

Location: Fully remote — UK business hours (9:00–17:30 GMT/BST)

Type: Full-time contractor 

Compensation: £1,000–£1,400/month base + uncapped commission on incremental revenue + occupancy bonus 

Reports to: Founder / Director



About Accommos

Accommos is a premium, tech-led short-term rental management company operating a portfolio of design-focused apartments across London. Our properties stand apart through wellness amenities — private saunas, cold plunges, hot tubs and cinema rooms — and a strict quality-first operating model. We hold Airbnb Superhost status and run on a modern stack: Guesty, PriceLabs, Enso Connect and heavily automated internal systems.

We are now building the commercial side of the business, and this role owns it end to end: pricing strategy, demand generation, B2B channels, ancillary revenue and guest lifetime value.



The Role

This is not a lead-sourcing or cold-calling position. You will be responsible for maximising total revenue per property across every lever available — rate, occupancy, length of stay, channel mix, ancillary income and repeat business. You will operate like a hotel revenue manager crossed with a commercial partnerships lead.

You will be the first dedicated commercial hire, working directly with the founder. You will have real autonomy, real data access, and compensation tied directly to the revenue you create.



What You Will Own

1. Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy

 -Run event-led pricing: map London demand drivers (concert residencies, stadium

 events, conferences, school holidays, sporting fixtures) months ahead and position rates before the market moves

-Optimise length-of-stay rules: minimum-stay laddering, gap-night and orphan-night auto-discounting, check-in day restrictions that eliminate unsellable one-night gaps

-Segment pricing by demand pattern: mid-week corporate vs. weekend leisure vs. mid- stay relocation, with different rate strategies for each

-Manage the PriceLabs configuration against a monthly RevPAR target per property, not just occupancy

-Run controlled experiments: test rate positions, LOS rules and offer structures, and keep what wins



2. Relocation & Corporate Demand

-Build and manage relationships with relocation agencies, insurance temporary-housing providers, corporate travel bookers, film/TV production companies and serviced- apartment agents

-Register the portfolio with corporate booking agencies and respond to RFPs for corporate housing programmes

-Pursue insurance housing panel placements (temporary accommodation after floods, fires and building failures) — long stays, reliable payers

-Negotiate corporate rates that protect margin while securing the occupancy floor



3. B2B Distribution Channels

-Get the portfolio listed with serviced-apartment agencies and booking platforms that feed corporate demand

-Build direct relationships with travel management companies and executive assistants at Canary Wharf employers

-Develop a location-hire channel for photo and film shoots: agency outreach, rate card, availability process



4. Guest Upsells & Ancillary Revenue

-Design and refine upsell flows for early check-in, late checkout, mid-stay cleaning, extended stays and wellness add-ons through Enso Connect

-Build packaged offers: wellness weekend packages, monthly-stay bundles, celebration set-ups — priced as products, not discounts

-Launch and manage gift vouchers and prepaid stay credits for the direct site Track attach rates per upsell and continuously improve timing, pricing and copy



5. Direct Booking Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

-Grow bookings on our direct website (
), working alongside our paid-ads freelancer

-Own the guest database: post-stay win-back campaigns, seasonal offers to past guests, and a repeat-guest recognition programme that shifts OTA guests to direct

-Build a referral mechanism for guests and corporate contacts

-Recapture lost demand: cancelled bookings, expired quotes and abandoned direct-site sessions get structured follow-up offers

-Improve on-site conversion through offers, copy and booking-journey feedback



6. Occupancy Gap-Filling

-Monitor the portfolio calendar weekly; identify soft periods 2–6 weeks out and act before they arrive

-Sell gaps proactively: outreach to corporate contacts, targeted past-guest offers, location-hire placements, strategic LOS relaxation

-Coordinate all tactics with the pricing strategy so gap-filling never erodes the rate position



KPIs

-RevPAR per property vs. target (the headline metric)

-Incremental revenue generated per month, by stream

-Portfolio occupancy vs. baseline, with rate integrity maintained

-Direct booking share vs. OTA share

-Upsell attach rate and ancillary revenue per booking

-Repeat-guest rate and guest database growth

-Number of active corporate/relocation/agency accounts producing bookings



What We Are Looking For



Must have

-3+ years in revenue management, commercial or business development within short- term rentals, serviced apartments, hotels, corporate housing or relocation services

-Demonstrable record of revenue you personally generated or grew — you will be asked for specifics and numbers

-Working command of revenue metrics: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, LOS, channel contribution, attach rate

-Excellent spoken and written English; confident and credible on calls with UK corporate clients and agents

-Consultative selling style: you listen, diagnose and propose — you do not script-read Comfortable running structured experiments and reading the results honestly Reliable remote setup: quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet

-Available during UK business hours



Strongly preferred

-Hands-on experience with dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond) and a PMS (Guesty or comparable)

-Existing knowledge of the London accommodation market and its event calendar

-Familiarity with relocation agents, insurance housing, TMCs or serviced-apartment agencies


/CRM lifecycle marketing experience



Compensation Structure

-Base: £1,000–£1,400/month depending on experience

-Commission: percentage of incremental revenue across corporate bookings, upsells, ancillary income and direct bookings (structure shared at interview; uncapped)

-Quarterly RevPAR bonus when the portfolio exceeds target

-Realistic year-one on-target earnings: £20,000–£30,000+



Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention

-Ground-floor commercial hire in a profitable, growing company — you build the function

-Direct line to the founder; decisions in days, not quarters

-A genuinely differentiated product to sell: wellness-led properties that photograph well, review well and command premium rates

-Full access to the levers: pricing, channels, partnerships, marketing — not a narrow patch

-Compensation that scales with the results you deliver



How to Apply

Begin your application with the word “sauna” so we know you read this far. Then include:

1. Your CV

2. A short note (max 200 words) describing one specific piece of revenue you personally created or grew — what it was, how you did it, and the number

3. A voice recording (1–2 minutes, Vocaroo or similar) introducing yourself as if leaving a voi
 for a relocation agent you want to work with



Applications without all three items will not be reviewed.

About Us:

We manage short-term rental properties in the UK market. We are scaling our operations and need a dedicated, results-driven Recruiter to take full ownership of sourcing, vetting, and building our network of reliable domestic cleaners, backup cleaners, and professional housekeeping teams across various UK locations.



Salary: $8.00 USD per hour (Full-Time / Part-Time)



Key Responsibilities:



UK Sourcing: Proactively hunt and source high-quality, reliable cleaners throughout specific regions in the UK using platforms like Upwork, Nextdoor, and local networks.



Vetting & Interviews: Conduct rigorous screening, structured interviews, and comprehensive reference checks to ensure top-tier reliability.



Database Management: Build, organize, and maintain an active database of active and backup cleaners to ensure zero service disruptions.



Agency Sourcing: Identify and negotiate terms with local UK housekeeping and corporate cleaning companies when independent cleaners are unavailable.



Onboarding: Assist management with onboarding selected candidates and implementing company SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).



Required Qualifications & Experience:



Niche Expertise: Proven track record specifically recruiting cleaning staff, housekeepers, or hospitality personnel.



UK Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with UK geography, hiring dynamics, and platforms popular in the UK (e.g., Upwork, Nextdoor).



Proven Upwork Portfolio: An excellent, active Upwork Freelancer/Recruiter profile with substantial positive reviews and verified hiring results.



Independent Drive: A "hunter" mindset—someone who doesn't just wait for applications but actively sources high-quality candidates.



To apply, please start your cover letter with the word 'SUPERHOST' and include a link to your Upwork profile.

title: Social Media & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
About Us

We're a growing chiropractic practice dedicated to helping our patients live healthier, pain-free lives. We've built our reputation on genuine care, strong systems, and a warm, professional presence — both in the office and online. As we grow, we're looking for someone who wants to take real ownership of how we show up on social media and help us build the marketing systems that support that growth.



Role Mission

As our Social Media & Marketing Virtual Assistant, you will own our social media workflow from idea to publication to analysis — not just execute a list of tasks handed to you. This position is crucial to building a consistent, strategic social presence that reflects our brand and connects with our community, while freeing up the practice owner from having to manage every step. As you grow into the role, you'll also support our Operations Manager with broader marketing and administrative work, contributing directly to how efficiently and professionally our practice runs.



Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, proactive professional with a genuine interest in social media and a track record of turning ideas into finished, published content. You are creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable researching trends and translating them into relevant, on-brand content. You thrive working independently, follow SOPs precisely, and aren't afraid to give candid feedback or ask questions when something is unclear. You're resourceful rather than someone who waits to be told what to do next, and you're looking for a long-term role where your responsibility — and your voice in the strategy — can grow over time.



Responsibilities & Expectations



Social Media & Marketing (primary focus — owning idea → plan → creation → publication → analysis):

- Research current social media trends, topics, and content opportunities within our niche

- Use AI tools to assist with research, ideation, content analysis, and workflow efficiency

- Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar and bring strategic content ideas to regular planning meetings

- Direct the practice owner on what content or raw video needs to be recorded, then turn raw footage into polished Reels and edited short-form video

- Write and refine captions; create graphics and carousels in Canva

- Schedule and publish content, assist with Instagram Stories, and repurpose existing content into new formats

- Monitor comments and DMs and respond appropriately within established guidelines

- Track social media analytics, identify what's performing, and recommend what to do more or less of



Marketing & Administrative Support (secondary, as you learn our systems, working with our Operations Manager):

- Run text and
 campaigns and build
 nurture sequences in Flo Desk

-  Create marketing graphics, complete data entry, and organize/update marketing data

- Support patient follow-up and reactivation campaigns, and respond to routine patient texts/emails using established processes

- Complete other documented backend tasks that don't require being in the office

- As this is a healthcare practice, some tasks may eventually involve our practice management/EHR system and direct patient communication — confidentiality, professionalism, and strict adherence to our privacy and security procedures are mandatory



Required Experience & Skills

- Extremely detail-oriented, organized, and reliable with deadlines and follow-through

- Proactive and resourceful — you notice opportunities and bring ideas rather than waiting for direction

- Creative, genuinely interested in social media, and skilled at turning trends into relevant content

- Strong written English communicator, comfortable giving direct, candid feedback and asking questions when something's unclear

- Able to follow SOPs precisely while also looking for ways to improve systems

- Comfortable learning and working with AI tools

- Experience with several of the following strongly preferred: Instagram,
, short-form/Reels video editing, Canva, social media scheduling, content calendars, copywriting/caption writing, social media analytics,
 marketing in Flo Desk, and AI-assisted research/content workflows

- Experience with a healthcare, chiropractic, wellness, or local service business is a plus, but not required

- Available approximately 10–15 hours/week to start (growing to 15–20 hours/week), with work completed primarily asynchronously

title: Data Support Analyst

• Collaborate closely with data engineering teams to optimize data flow and quality

• Utilize SQL, Excel, and/or similar tools to execute data cleaning and standardization processes

• Assist in creating operational reports and ensuring compliance with data standards

• Facilitate stakeholder access to clean, reliable data for analysis and reporting purposes

title: Bookkeeping/Payroll assistant
description:
Who We Are

We’re Sinclair Day Accountancy, a modern, people-first UK accountancy practice that believes work should feel meaningful and fun. We help businesses grow confidently, and we build lasting partnerships with the people who help us do it.

Now we’re looking for a Bookkeeper/Payroll Assistant in the Philippines — someone talented, proactive, and genuinely committed to being part of our close-knit family.

At Sinclair Day, you’re not “just another remote worker.” You’re a trusted member of our team. We celebrate reliability, loyalty, and integrity above everything else.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Providing excellent bookkeeping support to our UK clients

• Processing purchase invoices & managing bank reconciliations

• Reconciling control accounts

• Running smooth and accurate payroll

• Supporting UK VAT compliance (a solid grasp of VAT is a must!)



What We’re Looking For

• Strong knowledge of UK bookkeeping practices, especially VAT

• Experience with Xero and ideally Dext (we’ll train the right fast learner!)

• A self-starter who manages time well and takes initiative

• A team player with exceptional attention to detail

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Someone who takes real pride in doing things properly



Our Promise — and What We Expect in Return

We’ve built a culture of trust. Everyone on our team relies on one another to be honest, accountable, and open — even when things go wrong.

We understand that life happens. Wi-Fi drops. Deadlines move. Mistakes occur.

What matters to us is communication. Tell us the truth, early and clearly, and we’ll always have your back.

But if work isn’t being done or we’re not getting honest updates, that trust breaks — and trust is the foundation of everything we do.

So if you’re someone who values honesty as much as excellence, you’ll fit right in here.



Why You’ll Love Working With Us

• 100% remote — do your best work wherever you are

• Friendly, supportive UK team that treats you with respect

• Fast-growing firm where your work matters

• Opportunities to grow your skills and career with us

• A no-drama, no-micromanagement culture — built on teamwork and trust



How to Apply

Send us your CV and tell us:

• Why you’d be a great fit for our team

• Your experience with bookkeeping software (QuickBooks, Xero, etc.)

• Your experience processing UK Payroll — and which payroll systems you’ve used

• Your experience with UK tax types (and examples if possible)



Portfolio

If you’ve supported international clients or projects before, we’d love to see examples!



Final Note

We’re not just hiring for a position — we’re welcoming another member of the Sinclair Day family. We’ll train you, support you, and celebrate your wins… as long as you bring honesty, consistency, and heart.

If you’re ready to grow long-term with a team that genuinely values integrity and connection — welcome home.

title: Senior AI Automation Engineer | n8n + Ollama + Mac Studio Agent Builds
description:
Good catch. Stripped the dollar figures and replaced with neutral framing that still conveys "real client work, real stakes" without giving applicants leverage on what you bill.



JOB TITLE: Senior AI Automation Engineer | Build Multi-Agent Swarm on Mac Studio + Subscription Business OS

SALARY: $8 to $10 per hour USD to start, calibrated to demonstrated experience after technical assessment. Senior engineers move toward $15+ per hour as they take full ownership of build delivery.

HOURS: 40 hours per week, full time, long term

SCHEDULE: Overlap with US Eastern Time required (at least 4 hours daily)

TYPE: Direct hire. Not agency, not freelance, not project based.



ABOUT VIRAL GROWTH MEDIA

Viral Growth Media is a Tampa, Florida based digital media and AI automation company. We build full operating systems for high-revenue subscription, creator, and service businesses. We have an in-house Mac Studio M3 Ultra (512GB unified memory, 8TB SSD) ready to host a multi-agent AI swarm on n8n, Ollama, and botctl. We are not hiring you to maintain a running system. We are hiring you to build it.

YOUR TWO PROJECTS

You are not being hired to float across an open queue of small tasks. You are being hired for two named builds with defined scope, defined timelines, and defined deliverables. Both are greenfield. You are building them from zero.

Project 1: Build the Internal Multi-Agent Swarm on Mac Studio M3 Ultra (Greenfield)

The hardware is sitting and ready. The architecture is specified. You are building the system.



Stand up the Mac Studio M3 Ultra as a production inference host. Install and configure Ollama, n8n, and botctl. Lock down system access.

Build the 6-agent swarm from scratch. Each agent has a defined role (content generation, sales triage, monitoring, orchestration, and two more we will brief you on at intake). You will be selecting the right local LLM per agent workload (not just running one default model)

Build inter-agent communication, queue management, retry logic, and persistent memory layers

Build the observability layer: agent uptime, token throughput, queue depth, error rates, escalation triggers

Set up secure remote dev access (Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel) so this stack is operable without physical access to the machine

Document the entire swarm architecture so the rest of the team can operate it without you in the room



Project 2: Client Operating System Build (subscription business)

This is an active client engagement currently in proposal stage with a multi-month delivery timeline. You will be the technical lead on delivery. Scope includes:



Helpdesk migration off a legacy phone-based system onto a real ticketing platform (Help Scout, Freshdesk, or Gorgias) with an AI first-touch agent trained on the client's actual three-year support history

Knowledge base extraction and structured documentation

Internal operator dashboard with real-time visibility: active users, trial conversion, failed payments, support volume, app outages, daily revenue

Payment-to-panel middleware between payment processors (Stripe, 
, NMI gateways, Easy Pay Direct, Durango) and the client's dashboard layer

Multi-processor failover architecture so a single processor shutdown does not take the business offline

Automated dunning with retry queues and SMS +
 recovery sequences

Automated renewal processing, onboarding agent, trial follow-up, cancellation save flow

Customer database migration, deduplication, and clean-up



THE STACK YOU WILL WORK IN

n8n (workflow orchestration), Ollama (local LLM inference on Mac Studio), GoHighLevel (CRM, workflows, IG bot, tags), ActiveCampaign 
 deliverability), Whop (community, payments, gated content), Twilio (SMS, A2P compliant), Asana (project management), Google Workspace.

You will be writing JavaScript and Python inside n8n nodes. You will be calling local Ollama endpoints from n8n. You will be building webhook bridges between GHL, ActiveCampaign, Whop, Stripe, and custom panels. You will sometimes be touching raw API calls when n8n nodes are insufficient.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



3+ years building automation workflows in n8n, Make (Integromat), or Zapier with measurable production output

Direct experience deploying local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or similar). You should be able to tell us which models you have run, on what hardware, and what you learned about prompt latency

Strong JavaScript and Python. You write code, you do not just connect nodes

Direct experience with at least 2 of: GoHighLevel, ActiveCampaign, Stripe API, Twilio API, Whop API

Webhook architecture, REST API integration, JSON debugging, async error handling

English fluent enough to write client-facing documentation. You will be writing SOPs in Asana that paying clients will read



STRONGLY PREFERRED



Experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures from scratch (CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, or custom n8n agent swarms)

Payment integration experience with US merchant accounts and multi-processor failover architecture

Has built customer-facing AI support agents in production (not demos)

Has worked inside a Mac Studio or Mac Pro environment remotely via SSH or Tailscale

Has set up Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel for remote dev access to local infrastructure



WHO YOU ARE NOT

This is not for someone who has only watched n8n tutorials and built one workflow. It is not for someone whose only LLM experience is calling the OpenAI API. It is not for someone who has only ever maintained other people's infrastructure and has never stood one up from scratch. If your portfolio is screenshots of templates instead of production systems you have built and operate, this is not the role.

WHO YOU ARE

You build infrastructure from zero. You read a business and immediately see the leak points. You write clean docs because future-you and the rest of the team will read them. You ship work without being chased.

COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



Starting rate: 13 per hour USD negotiable based on experience, calibrated after technical assessment

Weekly pay

Paid holidays after 90 days

Formal performance reviews at 60 days, 6 months, then annually

Senior engineers move toward $15+ per hour as they take full ownership of build delivery

Direct line to the founder. No middle management layer.



HOW TO APPLY

We screen aggressively. Generic applications go straight to the archive. Follow these steps exactly.



Subject line must read: AGENT SWARM BUILD | [Your Full Name]

In the body of your application, answer the following in this exact order:



One paragraph on the most complex n8n workflow you have built in production. What did it do, what stack did it touch, what broke, and how did you fix it?

One paragraph on local LLM deployment from scratch. Which model, which hardware, which use case, and what was the bottleneck?

List the APIs you have integrated directly (not via no-code tools).

Your hours of availability in US Eastern Time.

Your current monthly billing rate or salary expectation in USD.





Attach or link to:



GitHub or GitLab profile (or equivalent code repo)

At least one screen recording (Loom is fine) of you walking through an n8n workflow you built. Two minutes is enough. Show the actual canvas, not marketing slides.

Any client testimonial or written reference





Do not send a generic resume PDF as your only application.



Applications that do not follow this format will not be reviewed. We get hundreds of applicants per posting. The filter is the test.

We are hiring one person for this role. Project 1 kickoff is immediate on hire. Project 2 kickoff follows shortly after.

title: Detail-Oriented Virtual Assistant - Quality Control (Design)
description:
About Us

We are a small, fast-moving design company producing a high volume of visual assets for client projects. Our work is highly visual and detail-driven, and our standard is simple: nothing goes out the door unless it looks right. As we scale our output, we need a second pair of eyes to make sure quality never slips.





The Role

You will be our Quality Control VA for design output. You are the checkpoint between production and delivery. Your job is to review visual assets against a clear checklist and catch what others miss - inconsistencies, sloppy details, anything that looks off or doesn't match the brief.



This is not a design role. You will not be creating assets from scratch. You will be reviewing, flagging, documenting, and occasionally requesting or triggering revisions.





What You'll Do

- Review design and visual output against our internal quality checklist

- Flag errors: inconsistencies, artifacts, wrong proportions, off-brand elements, typos, formatting issues

- Fix the issues you find yourself - correcting, cleaning up, and re-rendering assets until they meet our standard

- Do final checks before delivery to make sure files are complete and correctly formatted

- Help us improve and refine the QC checklist over time





What We're Looking For

- An exceptionally good eye. You notice when something is slightly off, even if you can't immediately say why.

- Precision and consistency. You follow a checklist the same way on item #1 and item #200.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools (image generation, AI-assisted editing, or similar). You should understand what typical AI output errors look like.

- Reliable written and spoken English

- Comfortable with repetitive, focused review work - this role rewards patience

- Reliable internet connection and a computer that can display visual work properly





Nice to Have

- Background in graphic design, photo editing, or video

- Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or similar

- Previous QA or quality control experience of any kind





Details

Position: Virtual Assistant, Quality Control (Design)

Hours: 48

Rate: $800 USD per month (full-time)

Schedule: flexible

Long-term position with room to grow as we scale





How to Apply

Please read carefully - applications that don't follow these steps will not be reviewed.



Solve this: 12 × 4 + 7 = ?

Put your answer as the first line of your application.

Tell us in 2–3 sentences about a time you caught a mistake that everyone else missed.

List the AI tools you have personally used and what you used them for.

If you have relevant work samples or QA experience, attach or link them.





We read every application that follows these steps. Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Operations Manager
description:
About the role



Formula Inbox is a boutique
 deliverability consultancy. We run cold outbound, marketing, and transactional
 programs for clients, plus white-label work for agencies. The business runs on a small distributed team of contractors, a set of documented processes, and a handful of client engagements running at the same time.



We are looking for an experienced operations manager to own the machine so the principal can focus on client strategy and delivery. This is not a task-taker role. You will coordinate contractors, keep client work moving through its stages, maintain our process documentation, and make sure nothing slips between the cracks across several concurrent engagements.



This is a part-time role to start, roughly 20 hours per week, with room to grow as the business does. Fully remote. You set your own hours as long as there is reliable overlap with US business hours and responsive async communication throughout the day.



What you will own



Contractor coordination. Assign and track work across our offshore contractors. Keep everyone clear on priorities, unblock them, and flag when something is behind before it becomes a problem.



Client operations. Move client engagements through their stages, from onboarding through delivery. Track deliverables, deadlines, and handoffs. Keep a clear picture of what is due, what is done, and what is at risk across every active engagement.



Process and documentation. Maintain and improve our internal SOP hub in Notion. When we find a better way to do something, you capture it. When a process is missing, you build it. You keep our documentation current instead of letting it rot.



Administrative and financial coordination. Help keep invoicing, contractor payments, and financial records organized in coordination with our bookkeeper. You will not be doing the accounting, but you will make sure the right things get to the right people on time and that nothing falls through.



Reporting and visibility. Give the principal a clear weekly picture of where everything stands without needing to be asked. Surface risks early. Bring solutions, not just problems.



What we are looking for



4+ years managing operations for a Western agency, consultancy, or services business, ideally remote and distributed

Direct experience coordinating other contractors or a small team, not just executing your own task list

A track record of owning a recurring process end to end, not just following one someone else built



Strong written English and clear, proactive async communication



Comfort with modern operations tools. We run on Notion, and touch Xero and Mercury on the financial side. You do not need to know every tool we use, but you should pick up new systems fast.



Reliable overlap with US business hours and a fast, consistent response time during the workday



Self-directed. You do not wait to be told what to do next. You see what needs doing and you do it.



Nice to have



Experience in a B2B services or marketing/agency environment



Familiarity with
, deliverability, or outbound (we can teach the domain, but context helps)



Experience building or cleaning up SOPs and internal documentation from scratch

title: GRANT WRITER AND GRANT SOURCING SPECIALIST
description:
ABOUT DAILY STRENGTH DEVOTIONAL



Daily Strength Devotional is a Catholic faith-based devotional ministry serving more than 30,000 users, primarily in Nigeria and other communities around the world.



Daily Strength provides digital and printed devotional resources designed to strengthen prayer, Bible study, faith formation, spiritual growth, and Christian community engagement.



Physical editions of the devotional are produced three times each year, in addition to digital content and resources.



--------------------------------------------------



POSITION SUMMARY



Daily Strength Devotional is seeking an experienced, proactive, persistent, and results-driven Grant Writer and Grant Sourcing Specialist.



This person will take ownership of the entire grant process, from identifying funding opportunities to preparing applications, submitting proposals, following up with funders, and supporting post-award reporting.



We are not looking for someone who will passively wait for opportunities.



The successful candidate must actively and consistently search for grants, build a strong funding pipeline, identify decision-makers, communicate with funders, submit persuasive applications, and follow each opportunity through to a final decision.



The goal of this position is to secure sustainable funding that can support the growth, programs, publishing, digital expansion, community outreach, faith formation, and service initiatives of Daily Strength Devotional.



--------------------------------------------------



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Conduct daily research to identify grants and funding opportunities that match the mission and programs of Daily Strength Devotional



- Search for funding from private foundations, Catholic foundations, Christian organizations, corporate foundations, international development organizations, government programs, family foundations, and other eligible funders



- Identify grants related to faith formation, religious publishing, digital ministry, literacy, education, youth development, family support, community outreach, technology, media, capacity building, and organizational growth



- Research funding opportunities available to organizations operating in Nigeria, Africa, the United States, and internationally where Daily Strength Devotional is eligible



- Carefully review every funder's eligibility requirements, geographic restrictions, funding priorities, deadlines, award amounts, and reporting requirements



- Avoid spending time on grants for which Daily Strength Devotional is clearly ineligible



- Maintain an organized grant database containing the funder's name, website, contact information, deadline, funding amount, requirements, application status, and next steps



- Create and maintain a detailed weekly, monthly, and annual grant calendar



- Prioritize the grants with the strongest alignment and greatest likelihood of success



- Prepare letters of inquiry, concept notes, expressions of interest, grant proposals, sponsorship requests, and complete funding applications



- Write persuasive and customized proposals that clearly communicate the mission, reach, impact, programs, needs, and future goals of Daily Strength Devotional



- Develop strong statements of need, project descriptions, goals, objectives, timelines, expected outcomes, evaluation plans, and sustainability plans



- Assist with preparing project budgets, budget narratives, financial information, and funding requests



- Gather and organize all supporting documents required for applications



- Develop a reusable grant document library containing organizational information, leadership biographies, program descriptions, impact data, budgets, testimonials, photos, registration documents, and previous applications



- Tailor every application to the specific funder instead of submitting generic or copied proposals



- Contact funders when appropriate to introduce Daily Strength Devotional, ask eligibility questions, request clarification, and develop professional relationships



- Attend virtual funder information sessions, webinars, and applicant conferences when necessary



- Submit complete applications before the required deadline



- Follow up consistently on submitted applications without becoming unprofessional or disrespectful



- Respond promptly to questions, requests for additional information, interviews, and due-diligence requirements from funders



- Track all applications as researching, preparing, submitted, pending, approved, declined, or funded



- Record the reasons for declined applications when feedback is available



- Improve future applications using funder feedback and previous application results



- Assist with grant acceptance documents and award agreements



- Monitor grant restrictions, deliverables, reporting deadlines, and approved uses of funds



- Prepare or support required progress reports, financial reports, outcome reports, and final grant reports



- Provide weekly reports showing grants researched, opportunities qualified, applications in progress, applications submitted, follow-ups completed, decisions received, and funds awarded



- Protect confidential organizational, financial, donor, and funder information



- Never fabricate statistics, partnerships, programs, financial information, beneficiaries, or organizational results



- Ensure every statement made in an application is accurate, supportable, and approved by Daily Strength Devotional



--------------------------------------------------



FIRST 30-DAY EXPECTATIONS



During the first 30 days, the Grant Writer and Grant Sourcing Specialist will be expected to:



- Complete a grant-readiness assessment for Daily Strength Devotional



- Review the organization's legal status, financial records, programs, existing materials, impact information, and supporting documents



- Identify any missing documents or organizational gaps that could prevent Daily Strength Devotional from qualifying for grants



- Create a master organizational profile and case for support



- Develop standard program descriptions, organizational history, mission language, and impact statements



- Create a grant calendar containing at least 25 carefully researched and qualified funding opportunities



- Identify the 10 strongest immediate grant opportunities



- Present a 90-day grant application strategy



- Begin preparing and submitting the highest-priority applications



--------------------------------------------------



ONGOING PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



- Research approximately 8 to 12 new, qualified funding opportunities each week



- Prepare approximately 2 to 4 high-quality applications, letters of inquiry, or concept notes each week, depending on their complexity



- Complete drafts before the internal review deadline



- Submit all approved applications on time



- Maintain complete and accurate grant records



- Follow up on every submitted application when appropriate



- Maintain a strong pipeline of immediate, short-term, and long-term opportunities



- Focus on application quality, eligibility, and funder alignment, not simply the number of applications submitted



- Communicate immediately when information, documents, approvals, or decisions are needed from leadership



- Provide a clear weekly funding pipeline report



- Demonstrate consistent progress toward increasing grant funding for Daily Strength Devotional



--------------------------------------------------



QUALIFICATIONS



- At least two years of professional grant writing, fundraising, proposal writing, or funding research experience is strongly preferred



- Proven experience identifying and qualifying grant opportunities



- Evidence of grants previously written, submitted, approved, or funded



- Excellent written and spoken English



- Strong persuasive, research, editing, and storytelling skills



- Ability to translate organizational programs and impact into compelling funding proposals



- Experience developing grant budgets and budget narratives



- Experience working with nonprofit, faith-based, Catholic, Christian, educational, publishing, media, technology, or international organizations is strongly preferred



- Knowledge of international grants and funding opportunities available to African organizations is highly desirable



- Understanding of foreign grantee eligibility, fiscal sponsorship, restricted funding, unrestricted funding, and grant compliance is an advantage



- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow complicated application instructions



- Excellent organization, time management, and deadline management



- Comfortable communicating directly with foundation representatives and funding organizations



- Able to work independently without waiting for constant instructions



- Persistent and confident without being dishonest, careless, or unprofessional



- Comfortable using Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, grant databases, online application portals, and project management systems



- Willing to learn the complete mission, history, programs, audience, and goals of Daily Strength Devotional



--------------------------------------------------



COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE BONUS



- The position includes an agreed base salary



- The employee may receive a fixed performance bonus for each qualifying grant that is successfully approved and funded



- The bonus will not be calculated as a percentage of the grant award



- The grant must have been sourced, written, or materially managed by the employee



- The opportunity must be properly recorded in the Daily Strength Devotional grant tracker



- The application must be accurate, complete, eligible, and approved by leadership before submission



- A grant is considered funded only after an official award agreement has been signed and the funds have been received by Daily Strength Devotional



- An approval letter or verbal promise without received funding does not qualify as a funded grant



- No bonus will be paid for grants that are pending, rejected, canceled, rescinded, returned, or never funded



- Bonus amounts and payment dates will be explained in the written compensation policy



- All bonuses remain subject to applicable laws, funder requirements, award restrictions, and professional grant-writing standards



--------------------------------------------------



IMPORTANT ETHICAL REQUIREMENTS



- The employee must pursue grants assertively but ethically



- The employee may not submit applications using false, exaggerated, copied, or unverifiable information



- The employee may not promise or guarantee that a grant will be awarded



- The employee may not offer gifts, payments, favors, or special benefits to influence a funding decision



- The employee must disclose any personal or professional conflict of interest involving a funder



- Artificial intelligence tools may be used only with authorization and must never replace proper research, fact-checking, original writing, confidentiality, or professional judgment



- All final applications must be reviewed and approved before submission



--------------------------------------------------



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is hungry for results, disciplined, strategic, persuasive, and highly organized.



This person understands that successful grant writing involves more than completing online applications. It requires continuous research, relationship building, careful positioning, excellent writing, consistent follow-up, accurate documentation, and a deep understanding of the funder's priorities.



The successful candidate will take personal ownership of the grant pipeline and will consistently search for new ways to bring sustainable funding to Daily Strength Devotional.



--------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



- Your updated resume



- A brief introduction explaining your grant writing and grant sourcing experience



- Two grant-writing samples, with confidential information removed



- A list of grants you have previously helped secure, including the funding amount, year, organization type, and your specific role



- A brief explanation of how you research and qualify grant opportunities



- A short 90-day plan explaining how you would begin finding funding for Daily Strength Devotional



- Your expected monthly base salary



- Your earliest available start date



- Confirmation that you are comfortable working under strict deadlines and providing weekly performance reports
